literature.headline_zh: 麻疹病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期麻疹病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 圆二色光谱显示,大多数 突变 降低了融合后核心的稳定性,尽管它们与增强的融合活性有关,并且报道了野生型 MeV 融合后核心的第一个晶体结构。 [10.1021/acs.biochem.6c00182]
根据受感染细胞表面积的测量,这两种化合物都减少了病毒传播,降低了病毒滴度,并且在 HRSV 的情况下,以剂量依赖性方式保留了细胞活力。基因集富集分析揭示了 MON-DNJ 调节基因集的特异性富集,表明 宿主 转录反应存在重叠。 [10.1016/j.antiviral.2026.106492]

该研究包括 16,703 名儿童,其中 81.5% 在活动期间获得了 MR 疫苗。疫苗接种 覆盖率在不同地区之间差异显着,Tabora 和 Pwani 的覆盖率较低,分别为 58.8%(95% CI:51.3%-65.9%)和 61.0%(95% CI:45.0%-75.0%)。Njombe 和 Mbeya 表现出较高的 MR 疫苗接种 覆盖率,分别为 97.4%(95% CI:90.5-99.3%)和 95.6%(95% CI:90.9-97.9%)。家庭财富五分位数和居住地、看护者的教育程度、看护者的年龄及其婚姻状况与坦桑尼亚大陆 9-59 个月龄儿童在活动期间接受 MR 疫苗接种 相关。空间分布揭示了 疫苗接种 覆盖范围的显着聚类(Moran's I = 0.34,p < 0.01)。 [10.1371/journal.pone.0330134]
所有模型在训练和测试数据上的 AUC-ROC、F1-Score 和 Brier Score 等指标上都表现出相似的性能。圣保罗市大都市区(州首府)和桑托斯(南美最大港口)一致确定 麻疹 风险最高。使用随机森林模型的决策阈值,共有 2 个城市被突出显示为高风险。 [10.1016/j.puhe.2026.106417]
该研究首次记录了CDV在野生动物中长期存在的证据(近十年)、跨越宿主物种屏障的爆炸性传播动态,以及来自连接北美和欧亚大陆的北极地区与黄石和其他北美谱系不同的毒株。 [10.64898/2026.07.20.739659]

news.headline_zh: 美国麻疹疫情创35年新高,特拉华州宣布暴发,口服抗病毒药物在动物模型中显示阻断传播潜力。
news.lead_zh: 2026年7月,美国麻疹病例数突破2300例,超过去年全年总数,达到35年来最高水平。特拉华州在确认4例未接种疫苗的成年男性病例后宣布暴发。同时,一项临床前研究显示,口服候选药物GHP-88310可在雪貂模型中阻断麻疹样病毒的传播,为疫情控制带来新希望。
key_findings_zh: 美国2026年麻疹病例达2318例,创35年新高,超过2025年全年总数,45个州受影响[news-93c691887d1536ab][news-a113acda91afe2da]。
特拉华州宣布麻疹暴发,肯特县4名未接种疫苗的成年男性确诊,卫生部门正进行接触者追踪[news-d5cebfdf87376c92][news-7883e79628ef41f0]。
口服抗病毒候选药物GHP-88310在雪貂模型中成功阻断麻疹样病毒的直接接触和空气传播,并缩短传染期[news-9fc4df9541fa7927][news-9a5b6db55d3c5379]。

亚利桑那州ICE拘留设施暴发麻疹,7名被拘留者检测阳性,已实施隔离措施[news-2939a54b6e343f75]。
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 美国正面临自1991年以来最严重的麻疹疫情,疫苗接种率下降导致群体免疫屏障受损,存在丧失麻疹消除状态的风险。未接种疫苗人群、孕妇、免疫功能低下者和婴儿面临严重并发症甚至死亡的高风险。

news.headline_en: U.S. Measles Cases Hit 35-Year High, Delaware Declares Outbreak, Oral Antiviral Shows Promise in Animal Model.
news.lead_en: In July 2026, U.S. measles cases surpassed 2,300, exceeding last year's total and reaching a 35-year high. Delaware declared an outbreak after four unvaccinated adult men were confirmed infected. Meanwhile, a preclinical study showed that the oral drug candidate GHP-88310 blocked transmission of a measles-like virus in ferrets, offering new hope for outbreak control.
key_findings_en: U.S. measles cases reached 2,318 in 2026, a 35-year high, surpassing the 2025 total, with 45 states affected [news-93c691887d1536ab][news-a113acda91afe2da].
Delaware declared a measles outbreak after four unvaccinated adult men in Kent County were confirmed; contact tracing is underway [news-d5cebfdf87376c92][news-7883e79628ef41f0].

Oral antiviral candidate GHP-88310 blocked both direct contact and airborne transmission of a measles-like virus in ferrets and shortened the contagious period [news-9fc4df9541fa7927][news-9a5b6db55d3c5379].
In Oregon, limited cooperation from affected households led to 40 unvaccinated students and staff being quarantined for three weeks after exposure, complicating containment [news-85011ffe8c14965e].
A measles outbreak at an ICE facility in Arizona resulted in seven detainees testing positive, prompting quarantine measures [news-2939a54b6e343f75].
news.trend_or_risk_en: The U.S. is facing its worst measles outbreak since 1991, driven by declining vaccination rates that threaten herd immunity and risk the loss of measles elimination status. Unvaccinated individuals, pregnant women, immunocompromised persons, and infants are at high risk of severe complications and death.
news.caveats_en: Case counts may be underestimated due to underreporting; the oral antiviral is still in preclinical testing and has not been evaluated in humans.

An ICE facility in Arizona reported seven positive detainees.

papers.title: Age Specific Hospitalization Dynamics During a Measles Outbreak in Nyanza District, Southern Province, Rwanda, 2026: A Survival Analysis with Implications for Clinical Management.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Measles remains a leading cause of vaccine-preventable mortality, particularly in low- and middle-income countries. Despite Rwanda's high routine immunization coverage and introduction of a two-dose measles-rubella schedule, persistent immunity gaps continue to drive localized outbreaks. Understanding how age influences hospitalization duration during outbreaks is critical for optimizing clinical management and resource allocation, yet evidence using robust time-to-event methods remains limited. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective cohort analysis of 56 confirmed measles cases identified during an outbreak in Nyanza District, Southern Province, Rwanda (February 16 - April 17, 2026). Demographic, clinical, and geographic data were extracted from routine surveillance records. Kaplan-Meier survival curves described time to hospital discharge stratified by age group. RESULTS: Among the 56 cases, infants under 9 months formed the largest proportion (44.6%), followed by adults over 15 years (25%). Geographic clustering was concentrated in Busasamana sector (51.7%). Age significantly predicted hospitalization duration (log-rank p = 0.00049), with children aged 5-15 years demonstrating the most rapid discharge by day 5, while infants under 9 months. CONCLUSION: Age was a significant determinant of measles hospitalization duration, with infants and adolescents experiencing the most prolonged clinical courses while school-aged children recovered fastest. These findings support age-targeted clinical triage and resource planning during measles outbreak response.

papers.title_zh: 2026 年卢旺达南部省 Nyanza 区 麻疹 暴发 期间特定年龄的住院动态:对临床管理的影响的生存分析。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Measles remains a leading cause of vaccine-preventable mortality, particularly in low- and middle-income countries. Despite Rwanda's high routine immunization coverage and introduction of a two-dose measles-rubella schedule, persistent immunity gaps continue to drive localized outbreaks. Understanding how age influences hospitalization duration during outbreaks is critical for optimizing clinical management and resource allocation, yet evidence using robust time-to-event methods remains limited. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective cohort analysis of 56 confirmed measles cases identified during an outbreak in Nyanza District, Southern Province, Rwanda (February 16 - April 17, 2026). Demographic, clinical, and geographic data were extracted from routine surveillance records. Kaplan-Meier survival curves described time to hospital discharge stratified by age group. RESULTS: Among the 56 cases, infants under 9 months formed the largest proportion (44.6%), followed by adults over 15 years (25%). Geographic clustering was concentrated in Busasamana sector (51.7%). Age significantly predicted hospitalization duration (log-rank p = 0.00049), with children aged 5-15 years demonstrating the most rapid discharge by day 5, while infants under 9 months. CONCLUSION: Age was a significant determinant of measles hospitalization duration, with infants and adolescents experiencing the most prolonged clinical courses while school-aged children recovered fastest. These findings support age-targeted clinical triage and resource planning during measles outbreak response.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:麻疹 仍然是 疫苗 可预防的 死亡率 的主要原因,特别是在低收入和中等收入国家。尽管卢旺达的常规免疫覆盖率很高,并引入了两剂 麻疹 风疹疫苗接种计划,但持续的免疫缺口继续推动局部 麻疹 的发展。了解年龄如何影响 暴发 期间的住院时间对于优化临床管理和资源分配至关重要,但使用可靠的事件发生时间方法的证据仍然有限。方法:我们对卢旺达南部省 Nyanza 区(2026 年 2 月 16 日至 4 月 17 日)暴发 期间发现的 56 例 麻疹 确诊病例进行了回顾性 队列研究 分析。人口统计、临床和地理数据是从常规 监测 记录中提取的。Kaplan-Meier 生存曲线描述了按年龄组分层的出院时间。结果:56例病例中,9个月以下婴儿所占比例最大(44.6%),其次是15岁以上成人(25%)。地理集群集中在Busasamana 区(51.7%)。年龄显着预测住院时间(对数秩 p = 0.00049),其中 5-15 岁儿童在第 5 天出院速度最快,而 9 个月以下的婴儿出院速度最快。结论:年龄是 麻疹 住院时间的重要决定因素,婴儿和青少年经历的临床病程最长,而学龄儿童恢复最快。这些发现支持 麻疹 暴发 响应期间针对年龄的临床分诊和资源规划。

papers.title: Host-directed iminosugars MON-DNJ and NB-DNJ inhibit measles virus and human respiratory syncytial virus replication in vitro.
papers.abstract: Measles virus (MeV) and human respiratory syncytial virus (HRSV) remain significant causes of global morbidity and mortality; measles in unvaccinated children, HRSV in infants below 6 months, immunocompromised, and the elderly. Despite the availability of vaccines and prophylactic monoclonal antibodies, there is a need for novel antiviral therapeutics. Both MeV and HRSV depend on correct glycosylation of surface glycoproteins (F and H for MeV, F and G for HRSV) for receptor interaction, entry, fusion, and cell-to-cell spread. Host endoplasmic reticulum (ER) α-glucosidases enable the proper folding of these N-linked viral enveloped glycoproteins via the calnexin pathway. Therefore, targeting those host-enzymes offers a promising broad-spectrum antiviral strategy. Here we demonstrate that the iminosugars MON-DNJ and NB-DNJ, which are inhibitors of ER α-glucosidases I and II, exert antiviral activity against both MeV and HRSV in vitro using different treatment protocols. Both compounds reduced viral spread as measured by infected cell surface area, decreased viral titers, and, in the case of HRSV, preserved cell viability in a dose-dependent manner. Gene set enrichment analysis of MeV and HRSV infection datasets revealed specific enrichment of MON-DNJ-modulated gene set, suggesting overlap in host transcriptional response. Antiviral activity to HRSV was confirmed in human airway organoids. These findings support the further development of iminosugars as host-directed antivirals against MeV and HRSV.

papers.title_zh: 宿主 定向亚胺糖 MON-DNJ 和 NB-DNJ 在体外抑制 麻疹病毒 和人呼吸道合胞病毒复制。
papers.source_body_en: Measles virus (MeV) and human respiratory syncytial virus (HRSV) remain significant causes of global morbidity and mortality; measles in unvaccinated children, HRSV in infants below 6 months, immunocompromised, and the elderly. Despite the availability of vaccines and prophylactic monoclonal antibodies, there is a need for novel antiviral therapeutics. Both MeV and HRSV depend on correct glycosylation of surface glycoproteins (F and H for MeV, F and G for HRSV) for receptor interaction, entry, fusion, and cell-to-cell spread. Host endoplasmic reticulum (ER) α-glucosidases enable the proper folding of these N-linked viral enveloped glycoproteins via the calnexin pathway. Therefore, targeting those host-enzymes offers a promising broad-spectrum antiviral strategy. Here we demonstrate that the iminosugars MON-DNJ and NB-DNJ, which are inhibitors of ER α-glucosidases I and II, exert antiviral activity against both MeV and HRSV in vitro using different treatment protocols. Both compounds reduced viral spread as measured by infected cell surface area, decreased viral titers, and, in the case of HRSV, preserved cell viability in a dose-dependent manner. Gene set enrichment analysis of MeV and HRSV infection datasets revealed specific enrichment of MON-DNJ-modulated gene set, suggesting overlap in host transcriptional response. Antiviral activity to HRSV was confirmed in human airway organoids. These findings support the further development of iminosugars as host-directed antivirals against MeV and HRSV.

papers.title: Persistent, Multi-Species Outbreaks and Long-Range Transmissions of a Measles-Like Virus
papers.abstract: Canine distemper---a measles-like disease with high mortality and presently without a cure---poses a major threat to wild and domestic carnivores globally. Domestic dogs are generally considered to be the main reservoir and long-range transmitter of the disease, but the role of wildlife is likely underestimated and the long-term persistence of CDV in wildlife has never been assessed. We sequenced canine distemper virus (CDV) full and partial genomes that were sampled over a decade (2012--2021) from Arctic foxes and other canids in Alaska and Yellowstone, and compiled a dataset of all published CDV genomes sampled across 32 species globally. We show the first ever evidence of persistence of CDV in wildlife (for almost a decade) with explosive transmission dynamics crossing host species barriers. Strains sampled from the Arctic for the first time connect North America to Eurasia, and are distinct from the Yellowstone strain and other known North American lineages. This suggests that separate wildlife outbreaks occur concurrently in North America, with possible introductions from Eurasia. The long-term persistence, long-range movement and explosive spread of this devastating panzootic virus that we document within wildlife is alarming and highlights the need for increased monitoring efforts to better protect wildlife populations globally.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Canine distemper virus (CDV), a measles-like pathogen with high mortality, threatens wild and domestic carnivores globally, yet its long-term persistence in wildlife and the underestimated role of wildlife reservoirs remain poorly understood.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study sequenced CDV genomes sampled over a decade (2012–2021) from Arctic foxes and other canids in Alaska and Yellowstone, and compiled a global dataset of all published CDV genomes sampled across 32 species.
analysis.methods: Full and partial CDV genomes were sequenced from field samples, and a comparative genomic dataset was assembled to assess phylogenetic relationships and transmission dynamics across host species and geographic regions.
analysis.main_results: The study documented the first evidence of long-term persistence of CDV in wildlife (nearly a decade), explosive transmission dynamics across host species barriers, and strains from the Arctic connecting North America to Eurasia that are distinct from Yellowstone and other North American lineages.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings reveal concurrent wildlife outbreaks in North America with possible introductions from Eurasia, highlighting previously unrecognized long-range movements and persistent transmission in wildlife populations.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results underscore the urgent need for enhanced surveillance and monitoring of CDV in wildlife to mitigate panzootic spread and protect vulnerable carnivore populations globally.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relies on genomic sampling and phylogenetic inference without experimental transmission or intervention data, limiting causal inference and generalizability to broader host ranges.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the long-term persistence and transmission dynamics of canine distemper virus (CDV) in wildlife, addressing a critical gap in understanding the role of wildlife reservoirs in global CDV epidemiology. By sequencing CDV genomes from Arctic foxes and other canids in Alaska and Yellowstone over a decade and compiling a global dataset, the authors documented the first evidence of nearly decade-long persistence in wildlife, explosive cross-species transmission, and Arctic strains linking North America to Eurasia. These findings reveal concurrent outbreaks in North America with possible Eurasian introductions, challenging prior assumptions about CDV reservoirs and spread. The genomic evidence highlights the need for increased surveillance to protect wildlife populations from this devastating panzootic virus.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 犬瘟热病毒 (CDV) 是一种具有高 死亡率 的 麻疹 样病原体,威胁着全球野生和家养食肉动物,但其在野生动物中的长期存在以及野生动物 死亡率 的被低估的作用仍然知之甚少。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究对十多年来(2012-2021)从阿拉斯加和黄石公园的北极狐和其他犬科动物身上采集的 CDV 基因组 样本进行了测序,并编制了涵盖 32 个物种的所有已发布 CDV 基因组 样本的全球数据集。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Canine distemper virus (CDV), a measles-like pathogen with high mortality, threatens wild and domestic carnivores globally, yet its long-term persistence in wildlife and the underestimated role of wildlife reservoirs remain poorly understood.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study sequenced CDV genomes sampled over a decade (2012–2021) from Arctic foxes and other canids in Alaska and Yellowstone, and compiled a global dataset of all published CDV genomes sampled across 32 species.
analysis_en.methods: Full and partial CDV genomes were sequenced from field samples, and a comparative genomic dataset was assembled to assess phylogenetic relationships and transmission dynamics across host species and geographic regions.
analysis_en.main_results: The study documented the first evidence of long-term persistence of CDV in wildlife (nearly a decade), explosive transmission dynamics across host species barriers, and strains from the Arctic connecting North America to Eurasia that are distinct from Yellowstone and other North American lineages.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings reveal concurrent wildlife outbreaks in North America with possible introductions from Eurasia, highlighting previously unrecognized long-range movements and persistent transmission in wildlife populations.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results underscore the urgent need for enhanced surveillance and monitoring of CDV in wildlife to mitigate panzootic spread and protect vulnerable carnivore populations globally.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relies on genomic sampling and phylogenetic inference without experimental transmission or intervention data, limiting causal inference and generalizability to broader host ranges.

papers.title_zh: 麻疹 类病毒的持久性、多物种 暴发 和远距离 传播
papers.source_body_en: Canine distemper---a measles-like disease with high mortality and presently without a cure---poses a major threat to wild and domestic carnivores globally. Domestic dogs are generally considered to be the main reservoir and long-range transmitter of the disease, but the role of wildlife is likely underestimated and the long-term persistence of CDV in wildlife has never been assessed. We sequenced canine distemper virus (CDV) full and partial genomes that were sampled over a decade (2012--2021) from Arctic foxes and other canids in Alaska and Yellowstone, and compiled a dataset of all published CDV genomes sampled across 32 species globally. We show the first ever evidence of persistence of CDV in wildlife (for almost a decade) with explosive transmission dynamics crossing host species barriers. Strains sampled from the Arctic for the first time connect North America to Eurasia, and are distinct from the Yellowstone strain and other known North American lineages. This suggests that separate wildlife outbreaks occur concurrently in North America, with possible introductions from Eurasia. The long-term persistence, long-range movement and explosive spread of this devastating panzootic virus that we document within wildlife is alarming and highlights the need for increased monitoring efforts to better protect wildlife populations globally.

papers.title: Spatial distribution and associated factors influencing 2024 Measles-Rubella vaccination campaign coverage among children aged 9-59 months in Mainland Tanzania: A multi-level mixed-effect analysis.
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Globally, measles remains a major cause of child mortality, and rubella is the leading cause of birth defects among all infectious diseases. In Mainland Tanzania, eliminating measles and rubella remains challenging due to geographical diversity, uneven healthcare facilities distribution, and socio-economic disparities across regions. Understanding spatial patterns and associated determinants of vaccination coverage is essential for improving campaign effectiveness. This study aimed to explore the spatial distribution and associated factors of measles-rubella campaign coverage among children aged 9-59 months in Mainland Tanzania. METHODS: A cross-sectional survey was conducted following the implementation of the February 2024 measles-rubella (MR) vaccination campaign to assess the spatial distribution and factors influencing MR vaccination coverage among children aged 9-59 months in Mainland Tanzania. Spatial autocorrelation was evaluated using Moran's I to detect clustering, while Local Indicators of Spatial Association (LISA) was used to identify High-High and Low-Low clusters. Hotspot and cold-spot analyses were performed using Getis-Ord Gi* statistics at the 95% confidence level, consistent with standard epidemiological reporting practices, to identify statistically significant spatial clusters. To identify factors associated with the campaign coverage, we used a multivariable logistic regression model. RESULTS: The study included 16,703 children, of whom 81.5% received the MR vaccine during the campaign. Vaccination coverage varied notably between regions, with Tabora and Pwani having a low coverage rate of 58.8% (95% CI: 51.3%-65.9%) and 61.0% (95% CI: 45.0%-75.0%) respectively. Njombe and Mbeya demonstrated high MR vaccination coverage of 97.4% (95% CI: 90.5-99.3%) and 95.6% (95% CI: 90.9-97.9%), respectively. The household wealth quintile and place of residence, caregiver's education, caregiver's age, and their marital status were associated with receiving MR vaccination during the campaign among children aged 9-59 months in Mainland Tanzania. Spatial distribution revealed significant clustering of vaccination coverage (Moran's I = 0.34, p < 0.01). The LISA identified two distinct categories of clusters: High-High Clusters (high-coverage) and Low-Low Clusters (low-coverage). High-High Clusters, which indicate regions with high MR vaccine rates surrounded by similar neighbors, are concentrated in regions such as Njombe and parts of Mbeya, whereas Low-Low Clusters, representing regions with low MR coverage, are found in areas like Tabora, Katavi, Dar es Salaam and Pwani. The Getis-Ord Gi* hotspot analysis shows significant clustering, with high-confidence hotspots in the southern highlands (Njombe and Mbeya) and notable cold spots in western Tanzania (Tabora and Katavi) and parts of eastern Tanzania. CONCLUSION: This study demonstrates substantial spatial heterogeneity in measles-rubella vaccination coverage across Mainland Tanzania, with persistent geographic inequities driven by socio-economic and demographic factors. These findings demonstrate how integrating geospatial insights with equity-focused planning can support precision public health planning, enabling targeted interventions to close coverage gaps and accelerate progress toward measles and rubella elimination.

papers.title: Estimating measles reintroduction risk in São Paulo using machine learning.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVES: This study aimed to develop a measles risk estimation tool to predict municipal-level occurrences in Brazil's most populous state, São Paulo. STUDY DESIGN: Measles risk for the 645 municipalities of the State of São Paulo was estimated by using public data spanning 2007-2023, integrated via the use and selection of machine learning models. METHODS: Five machine-learning prediction models were trained via K-fold stratified cross validation using publicly available demographic, mobility, socioeconomic, and vaccination data to predict annual measles occurrence per municipality. Model-specific decision thresholds to classify municipalities into high/low risk were obtained from the Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) curve evaluated on validation data. Shapley Additive Explanations (SHAP) on test data were used to identify the most influential features. RESULTS: All models showed similar performances across metrics like AUC-ROC, F1-Score and Brier Score on training and test data. The highest measles risk was consistently identified in the São Paulo municipality metropolitan region (state capital) and in Santos (largest South American port). Using the decision threshold for the Random Forest model, a total of 2 municipalities were highlighted as high risk. Passenger arrivals at international airports, WHO-reported cases along with municipal population size and population density were the most influential features, consistent with the current non-endemic measles scenario in São Paulo State. CONCLUSIONS: A measles risk-estimation tool is proposed for estimating measles risk in São Paulo State. Because it relies on publicly available data, the proposed framework may serve as a basis for similar initiatives in other Brazilian states or regions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在开发 麻疹 风险评估工具来预测巴西人口最多的州圣保罗的市级事件。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 圣保罗州 645 个城市的 麻疹 风险是通过使用 2007 年至 2023 年的公共数据进行估计的,并通过机器学习模型的使用和选择进行整合。
elements_zh.methods: 使用公开的人口统计、流动性、社会经济和 疫苗接种 数据,通过 K 倍分层交叉验证训练五个机器学习预测模型,以预测每个城市每年的 麻疹 发生率。将城市划分为高/低风险的模型特定决策阈值是从根据验证数据评估的接收者操作特征 (ROC) 曲线获得的。使用测试数据的沙普利加性解释 (SHAP) 来识别最有影响力的特征。
elements_zh.main_results: 所有模型在训练和测试数据上的 AUC-ROC、F1-Score 和 Brier Score 等指标上都表现出相似的性能。圣保罗市大都市区(州首府)和桑托斯(南美最大港口)一致确定 麻疹 风险最高。使用随机森林模型的决策阈值,共有 2 个城市被突出显示为高风险。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 提出了一种 麻疹 风险估计工具,用于估计圣保罗州的 麻疹 风险。由于它依赖于公开数据,因此拟议的框架可以作为巴西其他州或地区类似举措的基础。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以为高风险城市的针对性 麻疹 和预防策略提供信息,从而有可能改善圣保罗州的准备和响应。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于公开数据,这些数据在完整性或准确性方面可能存在局限性。证据强度中等,因为模型表现出一致的性能,但在非流行环境中的历史数据上进行了验证。

papers.title: Hyperfusogenic Mutations Destabilize the Postfusion Six-Helix Bundle of the Measles Virus Fusion Glycoprotein.
papers.abstract: Fusion of the host membrane and viral envelope by class I viral fusion proteins is driven by the assembly of a postfusion six-helix bundle formed through antiparallel interactions between N-terminal (HR1) and C-terminal (HR2) heptad-repeat regions. Although mutations in these regions of the measles virus (MeV) fusion (F) glycoprotein are known to promote neuropathogenic and hyperfusogenic phenotypes, their effects on postfusion core stability have not been systematically examined. Here, we combine peptide biophysics and X-ray crystallography to interrogate how mutations within the HR2 domain, present in native neuropathogenic MeV isolates ( e.g ., L454W and N462K) and laboratory-generated hyperfusogenic variants ( e.g ., L454M and T461A), influence postfusion 6HB assembly. Circular dichroism (CD) spectroscopy reveals that, with few exceptions, these mutations decrease postfusion core stability, despite their association with enhanced fusion activity. We also report the first crystal structure of the wild-type MeV postfusion core as well as structures of six hyperfusogenic variants, enabling high-resolution comparison of the molecular basis of destabilization. Structural analysis shows that these effects arise from localized perturbations to steric packing, hydrogen bonding networks, and helix-stabilizing interactions within HR2, while the overall 6HB architecture remains conserved. Together, these results indicate that hyperfusogenic mutations are not associated with stabilization of the postfusion state and are instead consistent with models in which hyperfusogenicity arises from a reduction in the energetic barrier to fusion, potentially through effects on prefusion stability or triggering efficiency. These findings establish key sequence-structure-stability relationships governing coiled-coil assembly and provide a framework for the design of HR1- and HR2-based fusion inhibitors.

analysis.methods: Circular dichroism (CD) spectroscopy was used to assess postfusion core stability, and X-ray crystallography was employed to determine the structures of the wild-type MeV postfusion core and six hyperfusogenic variants.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates how mutations in the measles virus fusion glycoprotein affect postfusion core stability, despite their known hyperfusogenic effects. Using circular dichroism spectroscopy and X-ray crystallography, the researchers found that most mutations destabilize the postfusion six-helix bundle, contradicting the assumption that hyperfusogenicity requires stabilization. The first crystal structure of the wild-type MeV postfusion core and six variants revealed that destabilization arises from localized perturbations to steric packing and hydrogen bonding. These results provide a molecular basis for hyperfusogenicity and a framework for designing fusion inhibitors, advancing understanding of viral fusion mechanisms.

papers.abstract_zh: I 类病毒融合蛋白的 宿主 膜和病毒包膜的融合是由融合后六螺旋束的组装驱动的,该六螺旋束是通过 N 端 (HR1) 和 C 端 (HR2) 七肽重复区域之间的反平行相互作用形成的。尽管已知 麻疹病毒 (MeV) 融合 (F) 糖蛋白这些区域中的 突变 会促进神经病理性和过度融合表型,但它们对融合后核心稳定性的影响尚未得到系统检查。在这里,我们结合肽生物物理学和 X 射线晶体学来探究 HR2 结构域内的 突变 如何影响融合后 6HB 组装,突变 存在于天然神经致病性 MeV 分离株(例如 L454W 和 N462K)和实验室产生的超融合变体(例如 L454M 和 T461A)中。圆二色性 (CD) 光谱表明,除了少数例外,这些 突变 会降低融合后核心稳定性,尽管它们与增强的融合活性有关。我们还报告了野生型 MeV 融合后核心的第一个晶体结构以及六种超融合变体的结构,从而能够对不稳定的分子基础进行高分辨率比较。结构分析表明,这些效应是由 HR2 内的空间堆积、氢键网络和螺旋稳定相互作用的局部扰动引起的,而整体 6HB 结构仍然保守。总之,这些结果表明,超融合性 突变 与融合后状态的稳定无关,而是与融合能量障碍减少而产生的超融合性模型一致,可能是通过对融合前稳定性或触发效率的影响。这些发现建立了控制卷曲螺旋组装的关键序列-结构-稳定性关系,并为基于 HR1 和 HR2 的融合抑制剂的设计提供了框架。

papers.title: Measles Vaccination Coverage, Caregiver Perceptions, and Information Sources in Five Selected Outbreak Districts of Zambia: A Descriptive Cross-Sectional Study
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Measles remains a significant public health concern in sub-Saharan Africa, with Zambia experiencing periodic outbreaks despite ongoing vaccination efforts. Understanding the determinants of vaccination coverage, caregiver knowledge, and information sources is essential for designing effective immunization programs. This study aimed to assess measles vaccination coverage, caregiver perceptions, and information sources among children in five districts of Zambia. Methods A cross-sectional study was conducted among 491 children aged 9 months to 15 years across five districts in Zambia (Chiengi, Kalabo, Kanchibiya, Mungwi, and Mwinilunga). Data were collected through structured interviews with caregivers, review of vaccination cards, and household observations. Descriptive statistics were used to characterize the study population, vaccination history, clinical presentation of measles cases, household environmental factors, and sources of vaccination information. Summary statistics are presented as frequencies, percentages, medians, and interquartile ranges. Results The median age of participants was 6 years (IQR: 2.6 − 10.0), with 57.6% being female. The majority (95.5%) resided in rural areas. Vaccination cards were available for only 29.5% of participants. Among cardholders, 97.2% had documented at least one routine measles dose, while 63.4% had received two routine doses. Caregiver recall indicated that 58.2% of children had participated in a measles vaccination campaign within the previous five years. Most caregivers (93.5%) believed measles is preventable. Health workers were the predominant source of vaccination information (98.8%), followed by traditional or religious sources (51.2%). Among 37 children with a history of prior measles illness, fever and rash were the most commonly reported symptoms (97.3% each). Household overcrowding was observed in 10.6% of households, and poor sanitation in 21.0%. Conclusions While vaccination coverage among children with available records appears adequate, the high proportion of children without vaccination documentation represents a significant gap in monitoring immunization status. Health workers remain the most trusted and utilized source of vaccination information. Strengthening vaccination record-keeping systems, improving community engagement, and leveraging multiple information channels could enhance measles vaccination coverage and outbreak preparedness in Zambia.

papers.title: Engineering Oncolytic Measles Virus with MG53 Couples Pyroptotic Tumor Killing with Immune Microenvironment Remodeling to Enhance Checkpoint Immunotherapy in Non-small Cell Lung Cancer
papers.abstract: Abstract Lung cancer is the leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, with only approximately 30% of patients benefiting from current immune checkpoint immunotherapy. Oncolytic virotherapy offers a promising strategy to overcome this resistance; however, achieving both potent tumor cytotoxicity and robust antitumor immune activation remains a major challenge. Here, we engineered oncolytic measles virus expressing the tumor suppressor MG53 (TRIM72), designated rMeV-MG53, and evaluated its therapeutic potential against non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). rMeV-MG53 retained replication kinetics comparable to parental MeV while driving significantly greater cytotoxicity than an unarmed control in NSCLC cells. Mechanistically, MG53 arming amplified caspase-3–dependent apoptosis and potentiated Gasdermin E (GSDME) cleavage, engaging GSDME-mediated pyroptosis as a key tumor-killing mechanism; pharmacological inhibition confirmed caspase-dependent apoptosis as the initiating event leading to pyroptosis, while excluding necroptosis and ferroptosis as significant contributors to rMeV-MG53-induced cytotoxicity. MG53 overexpression induced an intrinsic pro-inflammatory transcriptional signature enriched for TNF, NF-κB, and IL-17 signaling, and rMeV-MG53 elicited significantly stronger type I interferon and pro-inflammatory cytokine induction than the unarmed control. In an immunocompetent, MeV-permissive syngeneic NSCLC model, intratumoral rMeV-MG53 achieved superior tumor growth inhibition, amplified caspase-3/GSDME pyroptosis, selectively upregulated Cxcl10 , Ifng , and Il1b , and drove robust CD8+ T-cell and Granzyme B+ effector infiltration. This immune remodeling was accompanied by compensatory PD-L1 upregulation, and combining rMeV-MG53 with anti-PD-L1 blockade achieved the strongest tumor suppression of all treatment groups. These findings establish MG53-armed oncolytic MeV as a strategy coupling GSDME-mediated pyroptosis with antitumor immune remodeling to sensitize immune-resistant NSCLC to checkpoint immunotherapy.

papers.title_zh: 工程溶瘤 麻疹病毒 与 MG53 将焦亡肿瘤杀伤与免疫微环境重塑相结合,以增强非小细胞肺癌的检查点免疫治疗
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Lung cancer is the leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, with only approximately 30% of patients benefiting from current immune checkpoint immunotherapy. Oncolytic virotherapy offers a promising strategy to overcome this resistance; however, achieving both potent tumor cytotoxicity and robust antitumor immune activation remains a major challenge. Here, we engineered oncolytic measles virus expressing the tumor suppressor MG53 (TRIM72), designated rMeV-MG53, and evaluated its therapeutic potential against non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). rMeV-MG53 retained replication kinetics comparable to parental MeV while driving significantly greater cytotoxicity than an unarmed control in NSCLC cells. Mechanistically, MG53 arming amplified caspase-3–dependent apoptosis and potentiated Gasdermin E (GSDME) cleavage, engaging GSDME-mediated pyroptosis as a key tumor-killing mechanism; pharmacological inhibition confirmed caspase-dependent apoptosis as the initiating event leading to pyroptosis, while excluding necroptosis and ferroptosis as significant contributors to rMeV-MG53-induced cytotoxicity. MG53 overexpression induced an intrinsic pro-inflammatory transcriptional signature enriched for TNF, NF-κB, and IL-17 signaling, and rMeV-MG53 elicited significantly stronger type I interferon and pro-inflammatory cytokine induction than the unarmed control. In an immunocompetent, MeV-permissive syngeneic NSCLC model, intratumoral rMeV-MG53 achieved superior tumor growth inhibition, amplified caspase-3/GSDME pyroptosis, selectively upregulated Cxcl10 , Ifng , and Il1b , and drove robust CD8+ T-cell and Granzyme B+ effector infiltration. This immune remodeling was accompanied by compensatory PD-L1 upregulation, and combining rMeV-MG53 with anti-PD-L1 blockade achieved the strongest tumor suppression of all treatment groups. These findings establish MG53-armed oncolytic MeV as a strategy coupling GSDME-mediated pyroptosis with antitumor immune remodeling to sensitize immune-resistant NSCLC to checkpoint immunotherapy.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the ongoing measles epidemic and aims to identify evidence-informed approaches that schools can implement to promote childhood vaccination.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a review of evidence-based strategies for schools to promote childhood vaccination during the measles epidemic.
analysis.methods: The methods involve reviewing existing literature and data on measles outbreaks and vaccination promotion strategies in school settings.

papers.title: Measles in Ugandan Children Under 18 Months of Age: A retrospective study of case-based surveillance, 2018–2024
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction Measles remains a significant public health threat in Uganda, with regular outbreaks. The current national immunisation schedule offers the first measles-containing vaccine dose (MCV) at nine months, and a second dose at 18 months. We investigated the epidemiology of measles in Ugandan children aged 18 months and younger. Methods We analysed the national measles surveillance data from 2018 to the first quarter (Q1) of 2024, probing the demographic and geographic distribution. We categorised children as under six months, six to under nine months, and nine to 18 months. Suspected measles cases were classified as clinical, epidemiologically linked, laboratory-confirmed or discarded (not measles). Results 1316/2274 (57·9%) of the suspected cases were diagnosed with measles. 149 cases (11·3%; 95% Confidence Interval (CI): 9·7–13·0) were aged under six months, 390 (29·6%; 27·0–32·0) six to under nine months, and 777 (59·0%; 56·0–62·0) nine to 18 months. 717/1208 (59·4%; 57·0–62·0) of vaccine-eligible children, with a captured vaccination history, had received at least one dose of MCV. 59·5% (95%CI: 55·0 - 63·0) of measles cases were unvaccinated vaccine-eligible children. Several districts did not achieve the WHO-recommended measles surveillance threshold of at least two discarded cases per 100,000 population. Interpretation Most measles cases among Ugandan children ≤ 18 months are unvaccinated. Infants nine to 18 months old comprise most of the measles cases (59·0%; 777/1316). To achieve better control of measles transmission, review of the current vaccination policies with strengthened vaccination and surveillance systems are recommended.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines measles epidemiology in Ugandan children under 18 months, highlighting the significant public health threat posed by the disease. papers.title: Pediatric Measles and Visceral Leishmaniasis Co-infection: Diagnostic Challenges and Insights Into Pathophysiology
papers.abstract: Measles remains a major cause of childhood morbidity worldwide despite the availability of an effective vaccine. Beyond its acute clinical manifestations, measles induces profound but transient immune dysfunction, predisposing affected children to secondary and opportunistic infections. Visceral leishmaniasis (VL) is a systemic protozoal infection caused by Leishmania species and is characterized by prolonged fever, hepatosplenomegaly, pancytopenia, and high mortality if left untreated. The coexistence of severe measles and VL poses a significant diagnostic challenge because of their overlapping clinical and laboratory features. We report the case of a previously healthy three-year-old boy admitted to the pediatric intensive care unit with severe PCR-confirmed measles complicated by acute respiratory failure and hemodynamic instability requiring invasive mechanical ventilation and vasoactive support. Persistent fever, progressive hepatosplenomegaly, and cytopenias despite initial intensive management prompted further investigation, which demonstrated positive rK39 antigen testing and elevated anti-Leishmania antibody titers, establishing the diagnosis of VL. The patient was successfully treated with liposomal amphotericin B, vitamin A supplementation, IV immunoglobulin, and supportive intensive care, resulting in complete clinical recovery without sequelae. To the best of our knowledge, no pediatric case of measles-VL co-infection has been documented previously. This case highlights the diagnostic complexity of persistent systemic inflammation and cytopenias in children with severe measles and illustrates the importance of considering endemic opportunistic infections when the clinical course is atypical or prolonged. The favorable outcome emphasizes the value of early recognition, timely pathogen-directed therapy, and multidisciplinary management, while reinforcing the critical role of measles vaccination in preventing severe disease and its infectious complications.

papers.title: Investigation of measles outbreak in Pakistan (2022 to 2023): Exploring comorbidities, complications, and molecular characterization
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND Measles remains a major public health concern worldwide, particularly in regions with insufficient vaccination coverage and healthcare infrastructure, like Pakistan. The purpose of this study is to investigate the epidemiological, molecular, and phylogenetic characteristics of the measles outbreak in Pakistan during 2022-2023 and highlight the areas of improvement that can contribute to the better understanding of the disease and inform strategies for effective outbreak management and vaccination optimization. METHODS Throat swabs were collected from patients (n = 183) admitted at PIMS, Islamabad, Pakistan, from December 2022- December 2023. Statistical analysis of data was conducted on SPSS-21 software. The phylogenetics, amino acid substitutions, their functional analysis, and structural analysis of partial nucleoprotein were performed by using different bioinformatics software. RESULTS Most of the measles patients were infants with a high prevalence of comorbidity and complications, and significant number of patients had inadequate vaccination coverage. The phylogenetic analysis revealed relatedness to B3 strains circulating in Russia and the USA, emphasizing the global spread. The amino acid substitutions and structure analysis highlighted minor structural variations in current isolates as compared to the reference strain. CONCLUSION The findings underscore the importance of continuous surveillance and understanding of measles epidemiology and viral variations for effective outbreak management and vaccination optimization, ultimately aiming to mitigate the morbidity and mortality associated with measles outbreaks in Pakistan and similar settings globally. This study exemplifies the significance of interdisciplinary collaboration in confronting complex infectious disease challenges, emphasizing the imperative of continuous monitoring and preparedness in combating measles through vaccination.

The purpose of this study is to investigate the epidemiological, molecular, and phylogenetic characteristics of the measles outbreak in Pakistan during 2022-2023 and highlight the areas of improvement that can contribute to the better understanding of the disease and inform strategies for effective outbreak management and vaccination optimization. METHODS Throat swabs were collected from patients (n = 183) admitted at PIMS, Islamabad, Pakistan, from December 2022- December 2023. Statistical analysis of data was conducted on SPSS-21 software. The phylogenetics, amino acid substitutions, their functional analysis, and structural analysis of partial nucleoprotein were performed by using different bioinformatics software. RESULTS Most of the measles patients were infants with a high prevalence of comorbidity and complications, and significant number of patients had inadequate vaccination coverage. The phylogenetic analysis revealed relatedness to B3 strains circulating in Russia and the USA, emphasizing the global spread. The amino acid substitutions and structure analysis highlighted minor structural variations in current isolates as compared to the reference strain. CONCLUSION The findings underscore the importance of continuous surveillance and understanding of measles epidemiology and viral variations for effective outbreak management and vaccination optimization, ultimately aiming to mitigate the morbidity and mortality associated with measles outbreaks in Pakistan and similar settings globally. This study exemplifies the significance of interdisciplinary collaboration in confronting complex infectious disease challenges, emphasizing the imperative of continuous monitoring and preparedness in combating measles through vaccination.

papers.title: Discrete state-structured epidemic model with varying susceptibility and infectivity and its application to the measles outbreak in the United States
papers.abstract: Host individuals with vaccinations for infectious diseases often transition among different states of susceptibility and infectivity. Thus, we derive a class of epidemic models in which susceptible and infected individuals have a discrete set of susceptibility and infectivity states, respectively. Our model is based on double-dose vaccination and accounts for all possible state transitions between states. A comprehensive mathematical analysis of the proposed model is conducted, including assessing the control reproduction number and the global dynamical behaviors of the solutions. Using an improved affine-invariant ensemble Markov Chain Monte Carlo method, we also fit the model with measles case data in the United States. The results indicate that despite high vaccination coverage and efficacy rates, sporadic or small-scale measles outbreaks still occur. This suggests that reliance solely on vaccination policies is insufficient to fully interrupt its transmission chain. Consequently, enhancing the diagnosis rate of measles cases is another crucial measure for controlling measles transmission and outbreaks, building upon existing vaccination efforts.

papers.title: Nosocomial measles transmission in a multidisciplinary pediatric hospital
papers.abstract: To find out reasons of nosocomial measles transmission in the multidisciplinary pediatric hospital. Materials and methods. He study included 180 patients, 158 caregivers of hospitalized children, and 73 healthcare workers of a pediatric hospital. Measles case identification was performed using a standard case definition. Laboratory confirmation was carried out using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay to detect measles-specific IgM and IgG antibodies in blood serum, and polymerase chain reaction were used for differential diagnosis of respiratory viruses (nasopharyngeal swab). A 9-month-old female patient presented with a typical clinical picture of measles; nevertheless, the diagnosis was established 5 hours after hospitalisation. Contact persons (patients, parents/guardians) were identified using the «Ariadna» medical information system, healthcare workers were identified according on departmental staffing records. Contacts were identified among other hospitalized persons from March 25, 2024, to March 30, 2024, in the same wards or adjacent rooms sharing a common ventilation system with the infected patient. Due to delayed diagnosis, 411 contacts were identified, and 4 patients were re-hospitalised with a diagnosis of measles. Viral exanthems require heightened diagnostic vigilance, particularly during epidemic rises in incidence of highly contagious infections such as measles. Improvement of patient routing algorithms with exanthematous diseases in multidisciplinary hospitals is warranted.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the reasons behind nosocomial measles transmission in a multidisciplinary pediatric hospital. It included 180 patients, 158 caregivers, and 73 healthcare workers, with contacts identified from March 25 to March 30, 2024, in shared wards. Measles cases were diagnosed using standard criteria and confirmed with serological and molecular assays. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在调查多学科儿科医院院内 麻疹 传播 背后的原因,强调需要了解 麻疹 在医疗机构中如何传播。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究包括 180 名患者、158 名住院儿童的护理人员以及一家儿科医院的 73 名医护人员。2024年3月25日至2024年3月30日期间,在与感染患者共用通风系统的同一病房或相邻房间内的其他住院患者中发现了接触者。
elements_zh.methods: 麻疹 案例识别是使用标准案例定义进行的。实验室确认采用酶联免疫吸附法检测血清中麻疹特异性IgM和IgG抗体,采用聚合酶链反应鉴别呼吸道病毒(鼻咽拭子)麻疹。
elements_zh.main_results: 一名9个月大的女性患者出现典型的麻疹临床表现;尽管如此,诊断 是在住院 5 小时后建立的。由于诊断延迟,确定了411名接触者,4名患者因麻疹的诊断而再次住院。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果强调了及时 诊断 在预防院内 麻疹 传播 方面的重要性,特别是在患者路由算法可能需要改进的多学科医院中。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果强调,在 发病率 等高传染性感染(例如 麻疹)流行期间,需要提高诊断警惕性,并表明改进发疹性疾病患者路由算法的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其依赖延迟的 诊断 来识别接触者而受到限制,这可能会影响 传播 追踪的准确性。证据是中等的,因为它基于仅摘要的审查。

papers.title: Minor differences in the untranslated regions of measles vector additional transcription units are reflected by differential immunogenicity of encoded MERS-CoV Spike antigen
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The recombinant measles virus (MeV) is among those vaccine platform technologies, which are tested for the fast generation of effective vaccines against other pathogens, such as emerging virus diseases. Different live-attenuated vaccine strains have become available as backbones, with few differences. Here, we analyze how minor differences of recombinant Moraten (MV vac2 ) or Schwarz (MV Schw ) constructs have an impact on the performance of respective derived Middle East respiratory syndrome (MERS) vaccine candidates. MV vac2 or MV Schw viruses, both encoding the Spike glycoprotein (S) of the MERS-coronavirus (MERS-CoV) in an additional transcription unit (ATU) between the hemagglutinin gene and the polymerase gene L cassette, were tested. Both robustly expressed the additional gene. However, approximately twofold to threefold higher amounts of S proteins were observed in cells infected by the MV Schw -MERS-S(H) virus, correlating with the same relative ratio of S mRNA found in these cells. Exchange of the short genomic 3′ UTR ATU sequence in MV vac2 against the sequence in MV Schw enhanced gene expression by about the same factor and demonstrates causality. MeV-susceptible IFNAR −/− -CD46Ge mice vaccinated with either candidate reveal that higher relative S antigen expression by MV Schw -MERS-S(H) tended toward induction of higher specific antibody titers, but lower numbers of S antigen-specific T cells. analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand how minor differences in the untranslated regions of measles virus vector additional transcription units impact the immunogenicity of encoded MERS-CoV Spike antigen, addressing the need to optimize vaccine vector design for future pandemics.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study compared two recombinant measles virus strains, MV vac2 and MV Schw, encoding the MERS-CoV Spike glycoprotein in an additional transcription unit, using MeV-susceptible IFNAR−/−-CD46Ge mice for vaccination and challenge experiments.
analysis.methods: MV vac2 and MV Schw viruses were tested for Spike protein expression, and the 3′ UTR ATU sequence of MV vac2 was exchanged with that of MV Schw to assess causality. Antibody titers and T-cell responses were measured in vaccinated mice, followed by challenge experiments.
analysis.main_results: MV Schw-MERS-S(H) showed approximately twofold to threefold higher Spike protein expression and mRNA levels compared to MV vac2, with the 3′ UTR sequence exchange enhancing expression similarly. Vaccination with MV Schw-MERS-S(H) tended to induce higher antibody titers but lower T-cell responses, though both candidates provided effective protection in challenge experiments.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that minor genetic differences in the measles virus backbone can modulate antigen expression and immunogenicity, with the study demonstrating that such differences impact the balance of T-cell versus antibody responses without affecting protective efficacy in the model.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the design of viral vector vaccines by showing that subtle genetic modifications can tailor immune responses, enabling the development of vaccines optimized for specific immune outcomes, such as enhanced antibody or T-cell responses against target antigens.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate, as the study was conducted in a single animal model and focused on a limited set of immunogenicity outcomes, though the direct causal link between genetic differences and immunogenicity provides robust mechanistic insight.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated how minor differences in the untranslated regions of measles virus vectors affect the immunogenicity of a MERS-CoV Spike antigen. Two recombinant measles virus strains, MV vac2 and MV Schw, were compared, revealing that MV Schw expressed approximately two to three times more Spike protein due to differences in the 3′ UTR sequence. In mice, MV Schw vaccination tended to induce higher antibody titers but lower T-cell responses, though both candidates provided effective protection. The findings demonstrate that subtle genetic modifications in viral vectors can modulate immune responses, enabling tailored vaccine designs for specific immune outcomes.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在了解 麻疹病毒 媒介 附加转录单元的非翻译区域的微小差异如何影响编码的 MERS-CoV Spike 抗原的免疫原性,解决针对未来大流行优化 疫苗 媒介 设计的需要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究比较了两种重组 麻疹病毒 菌株 MV vac2 和 MV Schw,它们在额外的转录单元中编码 MERS-CoV Spike 糖蛋白,使用 MeV 敏感的 IFNAR−/−-CD46Ge 小鼠进行 疫苗接种 和攻击实验。

elements_zh.main_results: 与 MV vac2 相比,MV Schw-MERS-S(H) 显示出大约两倍至三倍的 Spike 蛋白表达和 mRNA 水平,3'UTR 序列交换也类似地增强了表达。疫苗接种 与 MV Schw-MERS-S(H) 倾向于诱导较高的抗体滴度,但较低的 T 细胞反应,尽管两种候选物在攻击实验中都提供了有效的保护。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,麻疹病毒 主链中的微小遗传差异可以调节抗原表达和免疫原性,研究表明这种差异会影响 T 细胞与抗体反应的平衡,而不影响模型中的保护功效。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,微妙的基因修饰可以定制疫苗,从而为病毒媒介 疫苗的设计提供信息,从而能够开发针对特定免疫结果优化的疫苗,例如增强针对目标抗原的抗体或T细胞反应。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,因为该研究是在单一动物模型中进行的,并且重点关注一组有限的免疫原性结果,尽管遗传差异和免疫原性之间的直接因果关系提供了强有力的机制见解。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 重组 麻疹病毒 (MeV) 是 疫苗 平台技术之一,该技术经过测试可快速生成针对其他病原体(例如新出现的病毒性疾病)的有效 疫苗。不同的减毒活毒株 疫苗 已成为主干毒株,几乎没有差异。在这里,我们分析了重组 Moraten (MV vac2 ) 或 Schwarz (MV Schw ) 构建体的微小差异如何影响各自衍生的中东呼吸综合征 (MERS) 疫苗 候选者的性能。MV vac2 或 MV Schw 病毒均在血凝素基因和聚合酶基因 L 盒之间的附加转录单元 (ATU) 中编码 MERS 冠状病毒 (MERS-CoV) 的刺突糖蛋白 (S)。两者都强烈表达了额外的基因。然而,在被 MV Schw -MERS-S(H) 病毒感染的细胞中观察到大约两倍至三倍的 S 蛋白含量,这与这些细胞中发现的 S mRNA 的相同相对比例相关。将 MV vac2 中的短基因组 3' UTR ATU 序列与 MV Schw 中的序列进行交换,以大约相同的因子增强了基因表达,并证明了因果关系。接种任一候选疫苗的 MeV 敏感 IFNAR -/− -CD46Ge 小鼠显示,MV Schw -MERS-S(H) 的较高相对 S 抗原表达倾向于诱导较高的特异性抗体滴度,但 S 抗原特异性 T 细胞数量较低。在随后的挑战实验中,两种候选药物均有效。因此,重组 MeV 的 ATU 遗传组成的微小差异可能会调节额外编码蛋白质的基因表达模式,这些蛋白质通过各自免疫原性的变化反映出来,但这对于所选疾病模型的保护并不是决定性的。重要性 如果出现新出现或重新出现的感染,需要 疫苗 平台技术来快速开发有效的 疫苗 以帮助流行病中的公共医疗保健。除了 mRNA 疫苗 之外,病毒平台技术,即腺病毒衍生的 疫苗 Vaxzevria 和 JCOVDEN,已被证明在 COVID-19 大流行期间具有巨大价值。对于未来的大流行,了解 媒介 设计中调节免疫原性的因素至关重要。这些知识允许定制 疫苗 媒介 以适应特定的目标产品概况,例如,构建 媒介 来触发增强的 T 细胞或针对感兴趣抗原的抗体反应。因此,我们使用减毒活 麻疹 疫苗 主链作为有希望的例子的研究对于证明 疫苗 主链中非常微小的差异可以改变 媒介 抗原系统的抗原表达谱并影响针对添加的靶抗原的 T 细胞或抗体反应的相对诱导至关重要。

papers.title: Age-stratified serosurvey reveals immunity patterns against measles in Youyang, China
papers.abstract: Objective To evaluate age-specific measles antibody dynamics and identify population immunity gaps in Youyang County, China, approximately two decades after the introduction of a two-dose measles-containing vaccine (MCV) schedule at 8 and 18 months of age. Methods A cross-sectional serosurvey was conducted among residents without rash in 2025. Measles-specific IgG antibodies were quantified using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), with seroprevalence defined as >200 mIU/mL. Seroprevalence and geometric mean concentrations (GMCs) were analyzed across eight age strata. analysis.summary_en: This study conducted an age-stratified serosurvey in Youyang County, China, in 2025 to assess measles immunity gaps two decades after implementing a two-dose measles-containing vaccine (MCV) schedule. Among 608 participants, the overall seroprevalence was 76.5% (adjusted to 81.5%), with significant variation: infants under 8 months had only 36.5% seroprevalence, young children (8 months–<18 years) had >95%, adults aged 18–<40 years had 65.6%, and older adults (≥40 years) had 90.1–93.5%. The findings reveal critical immunity gaps in infants and reproductive-aged adults, despite strong responses in vaccinated children. This serological pattern may be common in populations with early two-dose MCV coverage and low measles incidence, highlighting the need for targeted vaccination strategies to close these gaps and prevent potential outbreaks.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估中国酉阳县年龄特异性 麻疹 抗体动态并确定群体免疫差距,大约是在 8 个月和 18 个月龄引入含有两剂 麻疹 的 麻疹 方案约二十年后。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2025年,对酉阳县无皮疹居民进行了横断面血清调查,共8个年龄段的608名参与者进行了分析。
elements_zh.methods: 使用酶联免疫吸附测定 (ELISA) 对 麻疹 特异性 IgG 抗体进行定量,其中 血清流行率 定义为 >200 mIU/mL,并分析各年龄组的 血清流行率 和几何平均浓度 (GMC)。
elements_zh.main_results: 粗略总体 血清流行率 为 76.5%(IPW 调整率:81.5%),具有显着的年龄特异性变化;8个月以下婴儿的血清流行率为36.5%,幼儿(8个月–<18岁)的血清流行率>95%,18–<40岁的成人为65.6%的血清流行率,老年人(≥40岁)的血清流行率为90.1–93.5%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,这些发现揭示了 8 个月以下婴儿和育龄成人之间存在明显的免疫差距,尽管幼儿在 疫苗接种 后反应强劲,这表明这种血清学模式可能在 18 个月前接受过两剂 MCV 免疫且 麻疹 发病率 较低的人群中很常见。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为有针对性的 疫苗接种 策略提供了信息,以解决婴儿和育龄成人的免疫差距,有可能减少儿童 疫苗接种 覆盖率较高人群中的 麻疹 传播 和 暴发。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 尽管大样本量和精确的年龄分层分析提供了可靠的血清学见解,但由于横断面设计和对没有临床结果相关性的 血清流行率 数据的依赖,证据强度中等。

papers.full_text: Abstract Measles persists as a major public-health challenge in Ethiopia, where recurrent outbreaks are driven by suboptimal routine immunization and high susceptibility among children. To characterize these dynamics more accurately, this study investigates a fractional-order measles model using the Caputo derivative, enabling the incorporation of memory and hereditary effects that are not captured by classical integer-order formulations. Model parameters, including the fractional order, are calibrated using weekly Ethiopian measles incidence data. The best-fit model corresponds to \(\alpha = 0.86\) and yields a \(3.4\%\) reduction in Root Mean Square Error together with lower Akaike Information Criterion and Bayesian Information Criterion values compared to the integer-order model. Within this framework, a fractional optimal control problem is developed by introducing time-dependent vaccination and treatment controls. The optimality conditions derived via Pontryagin’s Maximum Principle are solved numerically to evaluate alternative intervention strategies. Quantitatively, the combined vaccination–treatment strategy reduces the final number of infections by \(94\%\) relative to the uncontrolled scenario at \(\alpha = 0.86\) and achieves a \(60\%\) reduction compared with its integer-order counterpart; it also lowers the total control cost by approximately \(28\%\) under fractional dynamics. Overall, the fractional model provides a more flexible representation of measles transmission by accounting for delayed response and long-range temporal effects inherent in real epidemics. The findings demonstrate that optimally timed, memory-aware vaccination strategies can significantly reduce both disease burden and implementation cost in settings such as Ethiopia, where gaps in routine immunization continue to sustain measles circulation. full_text_sections.full_text: Abstract Measles persists as a major public-health challenge in Ethiopia, where recurrent outbreaks are driven by suboptimal routine immunization and high susceptibility among children. To characterize these dynamics more accurately, this study investigates a fractional-order measles model using the Caputo derivative, enabling the incorporation of memory and hereditary effects that are not captured by classical integer-order formulations. Model parameters, including the fractional order, are calibrated using weekly Ethiopian measles incidence data. The best-fit model corresponds to \(\alpha = 0.86\) and yields a \(3.4\%\) reduction in Root Mean Square Error together with lower Akaike Information Criterion and Bayesian Information Criterion values compared to the integer-order model. Within this framework, a fractional optimal control problem is developed by introducing time-dependent vaccination and treatment controls. The optimality conditions derived via Pontryagin’s Maximum Principle are solved numerically to evaluate alternative intervention strategies. Quantitatively, the combined vaccination–treatment strategy reduces the final number of infections by \(94\%\) relative to the uncontrolled scenario at \(\alpha = 0.86\) and achieves a \(60\%\) reduction compared with its integer-order counterpart; it also lowers the total control cost by approximately \(28\%\) under fractional dynamics. Overall, the fractional model provides a more flexible representation of measles transmission by accounting for delayed response and long-range temporal effects inherent in real epidemics. The findings demonstrate that optimally timed, memory-aware vaccination strategies can significantly reduce both disease burden and implementation cost in settings such as Ethiopia, where gaps in routine immunization continue to sustain measles circulation. analysis.research_question_and_background: Measles persists as a major public-health challenge in Ethiopia, where recurrent outbreaks are driven by suboptimal routine immunization and high susceptibility among children. To characterize these dynamics more accurately, this study investigates a fractional-order measles model using the Caputo derivative, enabling the incorporation of memory and hereditary effects that are not captured by classical integer-order formulations.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study develops a fractional-order measles model calibrated using weekly Ethiopian measles incidence data. A fractional optimal control problem is introduced with time-dependent vaccination and treatment controls, and optimality conditions derived via Pontryagin's Maximum Principle are solved numerically to evaluate alternative intervention strategies.
analysis.methods: Model parameters, including the fractional order, are calibrated using weekly Ethiopian measles incidence data. The optimality conditions derived via Pontryagin's Maximum Principle are solved numerically to evaluate alternative intervention strategies.
analysis.main_results: The best-fit model corresponds to \(\alpha = 0.86\) and yields a \(3.4\%\) reduction in Root Mean Square Error together with lower Akaike Information Criterion and Bayesian Information Criterion values compared to the integer-order model. Quantitatively, the combined vaccination–treatment strategy reduces the final number of infections by \(94\%\) relative to the uncontrolled scenario at \(\alpha = 0.86\) and achieves a \(60\%\) reduction compared with its integer-order counterpart; it also lowers the total control cost by approximately \(28\%\) under fractional dynamics.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The fractional model provides a more flexible representation of measles transmission by accounting for delayed response and long-range temporal effects inherent in real epidemics. The findings demonstrate that optimally timed, memory-aware vaccination strategies can significantly reduce both disease burden and implementation cost in settings such as Ethiopia, where gaps in routine immunization continue to sustain measles circulation.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results inform the development of more effective and cost-effective intervention strategies for measles control in similar high-risk settings.

analysis.summary_en: This study addresses the persistent public-health challenge of measles in Ethiopia by developing a fractional-order model that incorporates memory and hereditary effects not captured by classical integer-order models. Calibrated using weekly Ethiopian incidence data, the model demonstrates superior fit with a fractional order of 0.86, reducing Root Mean Square Error by 3.4% compared to integer-order models. The introduction of time-dependent vaccination and treatment controls, optimized via Pontryagin's Maximum Principle, achieves a 94% reduction in infections relative to uncontrolled scenarios and a 60% reduction compared to integer-order counterparts, while lowering control costs by 28%. The findings highlight the potential of memory-aware strategies to enhance measles control in settings with routine immunization gaps, offering a more flexible and cost-effective approach to epidemic management.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 麻疹 仍然是埃塞俄比亚的一项重大公共卫生挑战,该国经常出现 麻疹 是由常规免疫不理想和儿童高易感性造成的。为了更准确地表征这些动态,本研究使用 Caputo 导数研究了分数阶 麻疹 模型,从而能够合并经典整数阶公式无法捕获的记忆和遗传效应。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究开发了一个分数阶 麻疹 模型,使用每周埃塞俄比亚 麻疹 发病率 数据进行校准。通过时间相关的 疫苗接种 和 治疗 控制引入分数最优控制问题,并通过数值求解通过庞特里亚金极大值原理导出的最优条件,以评估替代干预策略。
elements_zh.methods: 模型参数(包括分数阶)使用每周埃塞俄比亚 麻疹 发病率 数据进行校准。通过庞特里亚金最大原理导出的最优条件通过数值求解来评估替代干预策略。
elements_zh.main_results: 与整数阶模型相比,最佳拟合模型对应于 \(\alpha = 0.86\),均方根误差减少了 \(3.4\%\),并且 Akaike 信息准则和贝叶斯信息准则值较低。从数量上来说,疫苗接种–治疗 组合策略相对于 \(\alpha = 0.86\) 的不受控场景,将最终感染数量减少了 \(94\%\),并与整数阶对应策略相比实现了 \(60\%\) 减少;它还将分数动态下的总控制成本降低了大约 \(28\%\)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 分数模型通过考虑实际流行病中固有的延迟响应和长期时间效应,提供了 麻疹 传播 更灵活的表示。研究结果表明,在埃塞俄比亚等地区,最佳时机、记忆感知的 麻疹 策略可以显着减轻疾病负担和实施成本,在埃塞俄比亚,常规免疫接种的缺口继续维持 麻疹 的循环。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果为在类似的高风险环境中制定更有效和更具成本效益的 麻疹 控制干预策略提供了信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于埃塞俄比亚 麻疹 发病率 数据,可能无法推广到具有不同流行病学特征的其他环境。由于使用了真实世界的数据、严格的校准以及与整数阶模型的定量比较,证据强度很高。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 麻疹 仍然是埃塞俄比亚的一项重大公共卫生挑战,该国经常出现 麻疹 是由常规免疫不理想和儿童高易感性造成的。为了更准确地表征这些动态,本研究使用 Caputo 导数研究了分数阶 麻疹 模型,从而能够合并经典整数阶公式无法捕获的记忆和遗传效应。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究开发了一个分数阶 麻疹 模型,使用每周埃塞俄比亚 麻疹 发病率 数据进行校准。通过时间相关的 疫苗接种 和 治疗 控制引入分数最优控制问题,并通过数值求解通过庞特里亚金极大值原理导出的最优条件,以评估替代干预策略。
analysis_zh.methods: 模型参数(包括分数阶)使用每周埃塞俄比亚 麻疹 发病率 数据进行校准。通过庞特里亚金最大原理导出的最优条件通过数值求解来评估替代干预策略。
analysis_zh.main_results: 与整数阶模型相比,最佳拟合模型对应于 \(\alpha = 0.86\),均方根误差减少了 \(3.4\%\),并且 Akaike 信息准则和贝叶斯信息准则值较低。从数量上来说,疫苗接种–治疗 组合策略相对于 \(\alpha = 0.86\) 的不受控场景,将最终感染数量减少了 \(94\%\),并与整数阶对应策略相比实现了 \(60\%\) 减少;它还将分数动态下的总控制成本降低了大约 \(28\%\)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 分数模型通过考虑实际流行病中固有的延迟响应和长期时间效应,提供了 麻疹 传播 更灵活的表示。研究结果表明,在埃塞俄比亚等地区,最佳时机、记忆感知的 麻疹 策略可以显着减轻疾病负担和实施成本,在埃塞俄比亚,常规免疫接种的缺口继续维持 麻疹 的循环。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果为在类似的高风险环境中制定更有效和更具成本效益的 麻疹 控制干预策略提供了信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于埃塞俄比亚 麻疹 发病率 数据,可能无法推广到具有不同流行病学特征的其他环境。由于使用了真实世界的数据、严格的校准以及与整数阶模型的定量比较,证据强度很高。

papers.title: Evaluation of the measles surveillance system in Chereponi District, Ghana, 2019-2024
papers.abstract: Objectives To evaluate the design, implementation, and performance of the measles surveillance system in Chereponi District, Ghana, from 2019 to 2024 using the United States Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) Updated Guidelines for Evaluating Public Health Surveillance Systems. Study design Cross-sectional mixed-methods surveillance system evaluation. Methods A mixed-methods evaluation was conducted across all 26 health facilities implementing measles surveillance and 13 purposively selected key informants. Quantitative data were collected through facility assessments and review of Surveillance Outbreak Response Management and Analysis System (SORMAS) records. Qualitative data were obtained through semi-structured interviews. Descriptive statistics, predictive value positive (PVP), Cochran–Armitage trend analysis, and thematic analysis were performed. Results Timeliness was the strongest surveillance attribute (100%), followed by data quality (96.2%) and representativeness (88.5%). Acceptability (80.8%), simplicity (73.1%), and flexibility (61.5%) showed moderate performance, whereas usefulness (42.3%) and stability (38.5%) were weakest. During 2019-2024, 167 suspected measles cases were reported, of which 31 were laboratory confirmed (PVP = 18.6%; 95% CI: 13.4-25.3%). Laboratory confirmation rates increased significantly from 0% during 2019-2021 to 30.8% in 2024 (Cochran-Armitage χ 2 = 14.57, P < 0.001). Qualitative findings attributed operational weaknesses to inadequate refresher training, staff attrition, transport constraints, delayed laboratory feedback, unreliable internet and electricity, and inconsistent community-based reporting. Conclusions The measles surveillance system was functional and supported timely case detection, laboratory confirmation, and outbreak response within Ghana's IDSR framework. However, strengthening workforce capacity, logistics, laboratory feedback, digital infrastructure, and community-based surveillance is essential to improve system stability and advance measles elimination effort.

papers.full_text: Abstract The 2025/2026 measles resurgence in North America highlighted that antivirals may be valuable in protecting child health because of mounting vaccination hesitancy. The drug candidate GHP-88310 is an orally efficacious broad-spectrum orthoparamyxovirus polymerase inhibitor, but its effect on viral transmission is unclear. Here we used canine distemper virus, which causes measles-like disease in ferrets, and established direct-contact and airborne canine distemper virus transmission models to examine pharmacological suppression of virus spread. Prophylactic GHP-88310 administration alleviated clinical signs of direct contacts and all sentinels survived. Pre- and post-exposure prophylactic GHP-88310 given twice daily to air contacts prevented transmission. Once-daily prophylactic administration mediated complete survival with all air contacts undergoing seroconversion. Therapeutic treatment of air contacts mitigated clinical signs, and animals survived, whereas all vehicle-treated air contacts succumbed. Therapeutic treatment of infected source animals shortened the contagious phase by 5 days. These results establish conceptual proof that GHP-88310 can suppress social contact transmission. Therapeutic treatment of sources promises epidemiological gain in addition to therapeutic benefit. Main In 2001, the measles initiative was launched with the objective of establishing global measles virus (MeV) control through vaccination and a possible endgame of global measles eradication1,2. Enormous progress was made towards this goal, but global measles deaths have plateaued at around 100,000 per year since 2012 without further improvement3,4. Predominantly parental vaccination hesitancy has since resulted in re-emergence of MeV in geographical areas after elimination such as the UK5, facilitated persistent transmission in large regions including central and eastern Europe6,7 and in 2025 set the stage for the largest measles outbreak in decades in the United States with over 2,280 confirmed cases, hundreds of hospitalizations and 3 deaths8. Expanding from an epicentre in West Texas, thousands of additional cases were reported in Canada and Mexico8,9,10. Hospitalizations and case fatalities had no apparent impact on parental risk perception of vaccination versus infection11,12,13. As current trends project a further decline in vaccination rates14,15,16, future cyclical measles outbreaks in North America are inevitable, and additional options for measles control other than traditional ring vaccination are urgently needed to improve disease management and block virus spread. MeV is an orthoparamyxovirus of the morbillivirus genus17,18 that spreads through the respiratory route. All paramyxoviruses are enveloped, single-stranded RNA viruses of negative polarity that replicate in the cytosol of infected cells, relying on the virus-encoded RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (RdRP) complex for both amplification of their RNA genomes and expression of their proteins19. Measles first presents with high fever and coryza after an incubation period of 10–14 days, followed by the characteristic maculopapular rash, conjunctivitis and diarrhoea20,21. Patients become contagious shortly after the emergence of clinical signs and continue to shed the virus until approximately 4 days after the onset of rash22. Well-behaved antivirals may contribute to addressing the measles problem through improved disease management and suppression of viral spread beyond index cases. This intended use defines key parameters of the target product profile of a viable measles drug. The median survival of untreated source animals was until 11 d.p.i. (Fig. 1b), which fully matched our extensive experience with this model25,31. Clinical signs emerged first at 3 d.p.i. and comprised, in order of appearance, fever, body weight loss, rash, diarrhoea and conjunctivitis (Extended Data Fig. 1a–e). Animals became viraemic 3 d.p.i. (Fig. 1c) and started to efficiently shed virus into nasal lavages 7 d.p.i. (Fig. 1d). The median survival of animals in the cAC cohort was until study day 21 (Fig. 2b), indicating that transmission reliably occurred within the first 4–5 days of shared airspace. PEP cohorts, indicating complete suppression of transmission, and in 1 of 3 animals of the 6 d.p.c. therapeutic group. papers.title_original: Antiviral GHP-88310 blocks contact-mediated and airborne transmission in a ferret model of measles-like disease

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the efficacy of the antiviral compound GHP-88310 in blocking contact-mediated and airborne transmission of measles-like disease using a ferret model with canine distemper virus, addressing the need for interventions against morbillivirus transmission.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used a ferret model infected with canine distemper virus, a surrogate for measles virus, to establish direct-contact and airborne transmission models, with prophylactic and therapeutic treatment regimens evaluated in multiple cohorts.
analysis.methods: Researchers employed pharmacological suppression of virus spread, including prophylactic and therapeutic administration of GHP-88310, and measured transmission via clinical signs, seroconversion, viral load, and survival outcomes.
analysis.main_results: Prophylactic GHP-88310 administration alleviated clinical signs in direct contacts and ensured survival of all sentinels; therapeutic treatment of air contacts mitigated clinical signs and prevented mortality, whereas all vehicle-treated animals succumbed.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted GHP-88310 as a potent inhibitor of morbillivirus transmission, demonstrating complete suppression of airborne spread and sterilizing effects in some cohorts, representing a novel therapeutic approach.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest GHP-88310 could be a viable intervention for measles-like diseases, with implications for outbreak control and post-exposure prophylaxis in high-risk populations.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relied on an animal model with a surrogate virus, limiting direct extrapolation to humans, but the robust experimental design and consistent results provide high confidence in the findings.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the antiviral compound GHP-88310 in a ferret model using canine distemper virus to evaluate its efficacy against measles-like disease transmission. The researchers established direct-contact and airborne transmission models and tested prophylactic and therapeutic regimens. Results showed that prophylactic GHP-88310 alleviated clinical signs and ensured survival in direct contacts, while therapeutic treatment prevented mortality in air-exposed animals. The compound demonstrated complete suppression of airborne transmission in some cohorts, with sterilizing effects observed. The findings highlight GHP-88310 as a promising intervention for morbillivirus diseases, though the animal model limits direct human applicability.

analysis_zh.main_results: 预防性施用 GHP-88310 可减轻直接接触者的临床症状,并确保所有哨兵的生存;空气接触的治疗性 治疗 减轻了临床症状并预防了 死亡率,而所有媒介物治疗的动物均死亡。

papers.title: The 2026 Measles Outbreak in Bangladesh: A Critique of Immunity Gaps and Care Deficiencies
papers.abstract: Bangladesh entered 2026 amid a severe measles outbreak that peaked in mid-May. This article analyses the public health response to the outbreak and evaluates the government's management of the crisis. Health professionals and measles experts have attributed the outbreak to accumulated gaps in routine immunisation, weaknesses in public health infrastructure, poor nutritional status among children, widespread vitamin A deficiency, and maternal undernutrition during pregnancy and breastfeeding.
