papers.full_text: Disclaimer: Early release articles are not considered as final versions. Any changes will be reflected in the online version in the month the article is officially released. Volume 32, Number 9—September 2026 Dispatch Genomic and Epidemiologic Insights into Ongoing Measles Outbreak, Israel, 2025–2026 Suggested citation for this article Abstract An ongoing measles outbreak in Israel, involving ≈3,200 cases and 16 deaths, threatens the country’s measles elimination status and reflects declining vaccination rates observed globally and within Israel. Epidemiologic investigations supported by sequencing suggest that a single importation triggered the outbreak, underscoring the critical role of rapid genomic surveillance in outbreak control. Measles is a highly contagious, vaccine-preventable disease; clinical manifestations typically include high fever, maculopapular rash, cough, and conjunctivitis. Severe complications, including pneumonia and encephalitis, can occur in up to 30% of cases, and the case-fatality rate is ≈1/1,000 cases (1). Despite an effective vaccine (measles, mumps, and rubella [MMR]), measles remains a major global health concern; in 2025, Romania, Vietnam, Morocco, and the United States reported outbreaks (2–4). In Israel, MMR vaccine coverage has declined in recent years to 83% receiving the first dose at <25 months of age and 87% a second dose at <8 years of age. Corresponding rates are 83% and 85% in Jerusalem and 89% and 93% in the Central District; coverage is lower in Ultra-Orthodox communities (Israel Ministry of Health, unpub. data). Israel achieved measles elimination in 2015, but outbreaks continue, including >4,000 cases in 2018–2019 and smaller outbreaks during 2023–2024 (5–7). We report on an ongoing measles outbreak that began in Israel in April 2025. During April 7, 2025–February 28, 2026, a total of 3,203 measles cases, including 16 deaths, were reported across Israel, the largest outbreak since 2018–2019 (8). Epidemiologic investigations found 13 case-patients had a history of travel abroad shortly before illness onset (Table). Among reported case-patients, mean age was 5.58 years (SD 9.35 years; range 1 month–73 years); 82.7% were unvaccinated, 7.1% were partially vaccinated, 2.2% were fully vaccinated, and 8.5% had unknown vaccination status. As part of routine surveillance, 132 measles virus–positive samples collected during April 2025–February 2026 were selected for sequencing (Appendix). Samples were sequenced on the basis of the following criteria: all available imported cases, all travel-associated cases, representative samples from newly affected areas, and randomized samples collected in established outbreak locations every 2 weeks throughout the outbreak. Samples were excluded from sequencing when epidemiologic data showed that transmission occurred in established measles-positive locations (i.e., same street or household) (Appendix). Complete measles virus genomes were sequenced (9) (Appendix) and used for phylogenetic analysis to support transmission chain reconstruction. The N450 region of the measles viral genome confirmed the sequences as genotype B3, matching the reference MVs/Quetta.PAK/44.20 strain from Pakistan. Phylogenetic analysis showed the Israel sequences clustered most closely with sequences from the Netherlands and the United States collected in 2025 (Figure 1); however, because up-to-date global sequence data in public repositories are limited, intermediate diversity could be missing. The Israel sequences showed 3 likely clusters within the dominant B3 lineage, each derived from a separate documented importation: Belgium, Vietnam, and Russia. We found no spread of D8 lineage sequences imported to Israel. The Russia cluster likely originated from a documented importation from Russia (patient 4; Rehovot, May 2025) and is linked to an additional sample collected in Haifa in June 2025. That cluster is most closely related to a global sequence from California, USA (2025), differing by 7 nucleotides. Transmission in the cluster was limited to only 2 cases because close contacts were fully vaccinated and that location has high overall vaccine coverage. The Vietnam cluster, separated from the nearest ancestor by 12 nt, likely originated from a documented importation from Vietnam (patient 3; Beit-Itzhak, April 2025) and is not linked to additional Israel cases in the phylogeny. No further transmission was documented in the cluster, consistent with sequencing results and similar to the Russia cluster. The main and largest cluster (n = 129) was traced through epidemiologic investigations to a documented importation from Belgium (patient 2; Modi’in Illit, April 2025). That case was diagnosed retrospectively through contact tracing of infected close family members. Although the imported case was confirmed serologically (positive IgM), the available specimen contained insufficient viral RNA, precluding sequencing. However, sequencing was available for an epidemiologically linked close contact of the imported case (Bnei-Brak, April 2025; Figure 1, red arrow), located within the main cluster; epidemiologic data indicated subsequent spread to additional cities in Central District, Jerusalem, and later North District. That cluster also includes an additional sequenced importation from Belgium (case 5; Jerusalem, June 2025), unrelated epidemiologically to the other Belgium cases, located on the ancestral branch. The main cluster is most closely related to global sequences from the Netherlands collected in 2025, differing by 2 mutations. That strain has subsequently spread in Israel and is still circulating, accumulating mutations and giving rise to several sublineages. Most samples in that cluster were from locations with low vaccine coverage and within Ultra-Orthodox communities (Figure 2; Appendix Table 3). The sequences obtained from deceased children were located within different sublineages in the main outbreak cluster (Figure 1). The first case (Jerusalem, July 2025) was identical to 2 sequences detected elsewhere (Tel Aviv, September 2025; Emmanuel, August 2025). The second case (Jerusalem, July 2025) was identical to another from Jerusalem (June 2025). The third case (Poriya, November 2025) was identical to 2 cases from the North District (Nahariya, November 2025). The identical genomes suggest close epidemiologic linkage and, when detected in different districts, indicate transmission across multiple regions in Israel. That finding suggests the virus in fatal cases was typical of the outbreak strain. Three additional case-patients with documented travel abroad (patient 7, Poland; patient 10, Ethiopia; patient 12, Germany) near the time of measles detection had sequences within the main cluster, suggesting that infection was more likely acquired in Israel, not abroad. To investigate positivity dynamics from an epidemiologic perspective, we evaluated the weekly ratios of positive and negative samples collected during April–October 2025 (epidemiologic weeks 14–44). When the outbreak began, the positivity rate was low (10%–20%), likely reflecting heightened awareness and broad testing of suspected cases with low pretest probability for measles. As transmission became established in specific districts during weeks 28–38, positivity increased to ≈60%, indicating outbreak persistence and targeted sampling (Appendix). During weeks 39–44, as the outbreak expanded to additional districts, the overall ratio decreased (Figure 3); we observed a similar trend through February 2026 (data not shown). The ongoing measles outbreak in Israel threatens the country’s elimination status, defined by the World Health Organization as absence of endemic transmission for >12 months (https://iris.who.int/server/api/core/bitstreams/b0ee4708-ba01-4b40-9003-f6f1aba317da/content). This outbreak highlights the profound risks associated with declining vaccination coverage. Genomic sequencing of targeted measles samples indicated that a single importation event was most likely the primary driver of the outbreak. Phylogenetic analysis showed 3 validated distinct importation events from Russia, Vietnam, and Belgium; outcomes differed drastically based on local immunity. The main Belgium-linked cluster strain, detected in April 2025, likely sparked an extensive national outbreak. The second documented importation case from Belgium might have contributed to the main transmission cluster. The epidemiologic investigation indicated that this case-patient had many contacts and resided in an area experiencing a substantial outbreak. However, the case was detected 2 months after the Belgium index case, so it likely had little impact on outbreak dynamics. Furthermore, its shared mutations with the April 2025 Belgium case suggest a common source. Additional undetected single cases might exist because of underreporting. However, our strict criteria and direct contact to Ministry of Health epidemiologic data enabled systematic assessment of each focal point, so underreporting is unlikely to have substantially affected the main phylogenetic findings. Positivity rates rose from 10%–20% during early broad testing to 60% during weeks 28–38, as diagnostics shifted to targeted surveillance during outbreak spread. In summary, we integrated epidemiologic investigations with molecular surveillance, demonstrating that a single case can spark extensive measles transmission. Our findings highlight the critical role of molecular surveillance in measles outbreak management. Volume 32, Number 9—September 2026 Dispatch Genomic and Epidemiologic Insights into Ongoing Measles Outbreak, Israel, 2025–2026 Suggested citation for this article Abstract An ongoing measles outbreak in Israel, involving ≈3,200 cases and 16 deaths, threatens the country’s measles elimination status and reflects declining vaccination rates observed globally and within Israel. Epidemiologic investigations supported by sequencing suggest that a single importation triggered the outbreak, underscoring the critical role of rapid genomic surveillance in outbreak control. Measles is a highly contagious, vaccine-preventable disease; clinical manifestations typically include high fever, maculopapular rash, cough, and conjunctivitis. Severe complications, including pneumonia and encephalitis, can occur in up to 30% of cases, and the case-fatality rate is ≈1/1,000 cases (1). Despite an effective vaccine (measles, mumps, and rubella [MMR]), measles remains a major global health concern; in 2025, Romania, Vietnam, Morocco, and the United States reported outbreaks (2–4). In Israel, MMR vaccine coverage has declined in recent years to 83% receiving the first dose at <25 months of age and 87% a second dose at <8 years of age. Corresponding rates are 83% and 85% in Jerusalem and 89% and 93% in the Central District; coverage is lower in Ultra-Orthodox communities (Israel Ministry of Health, unpub. data). Israel achieved measles elimination in 2015, but outbreaks continue, including >4,000 cases in 2018–2019 and smaller outbreaks during 2023–2024 (5–7). We report on an ongoing measles outbreak that began in Israel in April 2025. During April 7, 2025–February 28, 2026, a total of 3,203 measles cases, including 16 deaths, were reported across Israel, the largest outbreak since 2018–2019 (8). Epidemiologic investigations found 13 case-patients had a history of travel abroad shortly before illness onset (Table). Among reported case-patients, mean age was 5.58 years (SD 9.35 years; range 1 month–73 years); 82.7% were unvaccinated, 7.1% were partially vaccinated, 2.2% were fully vaccinated, and 8.5% had unknown vaccination status. As part of routine surveillance, 132 measles virus–positive samples collected during April 2025–February 2026 were selected for sequencing (Appendix). Samples were sequenced on the basis of the following criteria: all available imported cases, all travel-associated cases, representative samples from newly affected areas, and randomized samples collected in established outbreak locations every 2 weeks throughout the outbreak. Samples were excluded from sequencing when epidemiologic data showed that transmission occurred in established measles-positive locations (i.e., same street or household) (Appendix). Complete measles virus genomes were sequenced (9) (Appendix) and used for phylogenetic analysis to support transmission chain reconstruction. The N450 region of the measles viral genome confirmed the sequences as genotype B3, matching the reference MVs/Quetta.PAK/44.20 strain from Pakistan. Phylogenetic analysis showed the Israel sequences clustered most closely with sequences from the Netherlands and the United States collected in 2025 (Figure 1); however, because up-to-date global sequence data in public repositories are limited, intermediate diversity could be missing. The Israel sequences showed 3 likely clusters within the dominant B3 lineage, each derived from a separate documented importation: Belgium, Vietnam, and Russia. We found no spread of D8 lineage sequences imported to Israel. The Russia cluster likely originated from a documented importation from Russia (patient 4; Rehovot, May 2025) and is linked to an additional sample collected in Haifa in June 2025. That cluster is most closely related to a global sequence from California, USA (2025), differing by 7 nucleotides. Transmission in the cluster was limited to only 2 cases because close contacts were fully vaccinated and that location has high overall vaccine coverage. The Vietnam cluster, separated from the nearest ancestor by 12 nt, likely originated from a documented importation from Vietnam (patient 3; Beit-Itzhak, April 2025) and is not linked to additional Israel cases in the phylogeny. No further transmission was documented in the cluster, consistent with sequencing results and similar to the Russia cluster. The main and largest cluster (n = 129) was traced through epidemiologic investigations to a documented importation from Belgium (patient 2; Modi’in Illit, April 2025). That case was diagnosed retrospectively through contact tracing of infected close family members. Although the imported case was confirmed serologically (positive IgM), the available specimen contained insufficient viral RNA, precluding sequencing. However, sequencing was available for an epidemiologically linked close contact of the imported case (Bnei-Brak, April 2025; Figure 1, red arrow), located within the main cluster; epidemiologic data indicated subsequent spread to additional cities in Central District, Jerusalem, and later North District. That cluster also includes an additional sequenced importation from Belgium (case 5; Jerusalem, June 2025), unrelated epidemiologically to the other Belgium cases, located on the ancestral branch. The main cluster is most closely related to global sequences from the Netherlands collected in 2025, differing by 2 mutations. That strain has subsequently spread in Israel and is still circulating, accumulating mutations and giving rise to several sublineages. Most samples in that cluster were from locations with low vaccine coverage and within Ultra-Orthodox communities (Figure 2; Appendix Table 3). The sequences obtained from deceased children were located within different sublineages in the main outbreak cluster (Figure 1). The first case (Jerusalem, July 2025) was identical to 2 sequences detected elsewhere (Tel Aviv, September 2025; Emmanuel, August 2025). The second case (Jerusalem, July 2025) was identical to another from Jerusalem (June 2025). The third case (Poriya, November 2025) was identical to 2 cases from the North District (Nahariya, November 2025). The identical genomes suggest close epidemiologic linkage and, when detected in different districts, indicate transmission across multiple regions in Israel. That finding suggests the virus in fatal cases was typical of the outbreak strain. Three additional case-patients with documented travel abroad (patient 7, Poland; patient 10, Ethiopia; patient 12, Germany) near the time of measles detection had sequences within the main cluster, suggesting that infection was more likely acquired in Israel, not abroad. To investigate positivity dynamics from an epidemiologic perspective, we evaluated the weekly ratios of positive and negative samples collected during April–October 2025 (epidemiologic weeks 14–44). When the outbreak began, the positivity rate was low (10%–20%), likely reflecting heightened awareness and broad testing of suspected cases with low pretest probability for measles. As transmission became established in specific districts during weeks 28–38, positivity increased to ≈60%, indicating outbreak persistence and targeted sampling (Appendix). During weeks 39–44, as the outbreak expanded to additional districts, the overall ratio decreased (Figure 3); we observed a similar trend through February 2026 (data not shown). The ongoing measles outbreak in Israel threatens the country’s elimination status, defined by the World Health Organization as absence of endemic transmission for >12 months (https://iris.who.int/server/api/core/bitstreams/b0ee4708-ba01-4b40-9003-f6f1aba317da/content). papers.title_original: Genomic and Epidemiologic Insights into Ongoing Measles Outbreak, Israel, 2025–2026

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study was needed to investigate an ongoing measles outbreak in Israel that threatened the country's measles elimination status and reflected declining vaccination rates globally and within Israel.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A genomic and epidemiologic investigation was conducted in Israel from April 2025 to February 2026, involving 3,203 reported measles cases, including 16 deaths, with samples sequenced from 132 measles virus-positive cases.
analysis.methods: Epidemiologic investigations supported by sequencing were performed, with samples selected based on criteria including imported cases, travel-associated cases, representative samples from newly affected areas, and randomized samples from established outbreak locations every 2 weeks.
analysis.main_results: Phylogenetic analysis showed the Israel sequences clustered most closely with sequences from the Netherlands and the United States, with 3 likely clusters within the dominant B3 lineage derived from separate importations from Belgium, Vietnam, and Russia; 82.7% of reported case-patients were unvaccinated.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that a single importation event was most likely the primary driver of the outbreak, with outcomes differing drastically based on local immunity, and highlighted the critical role of molecular surveillance in measles outbreak management.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the importance of maintaining high vaccination coverage and rapid genomic surveillance for measles outbreak control, as declining vaccination coverage poses profound risks to measles elimination status.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate, limited by the exclusion of samples from established measles-positive locations and the lack of up-to-date global sequence data in public repositories, which could result in missing intermediate diversity.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated a major measles outbreak in Israel from April 2025 to February 2026, involving 3,203 cases and 16 deaths, threatening the country's measles elimination status. Genomic and epidemiologic analyses revealed that the outbreak was primarily driven by three separate importation events from Belgium, Vietnam, and Russia, with the largest cluster traced to an imported case from Belgium. The majority of cases (82.7%) were unvaccinated, highlighting the impact of declining vaccination coverage. Phylogenetic analysis showed clustering with sequences from the Netherlands and the United States, and the study emphasized the critical role of molecular surveillance in outbreak management. The findings underscore the risks associated with low vaccination rates and the importance of targeted surveillance during outbreaks.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 这项研究需要调查以色列正在进行的 麻疹 麻疹,该事件威胁到该国的 麻疹 消除状态,并反映了全球和以色列境内 麻疹 率下降的情况。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2025年4月至2026年2月在以色列进行了一项基因组和流行病学调查,涉及3,203例报告的麻疹病例,其中16例死亡,并对132例麻疹病毒阳性病例的样本进行了测序。
elements_zh.methods: 进行了流行病学调查并辅以测序支持,样本选择标准包括输入性病例、关联性病例、新影响区域的代表性样本以及每2周从已建立的暴发地点随机抽取的样本。
elements_zh.main_results: 系统发育分析显示,以色列序列与来自荷兰和美国的序列聚类最为紧密,其中 3 个可能的聚类属于主要 B3 谱系,分别来自比利时、越南和俄罗斯;82.7%的报告病例未接种疫苗。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,单一输入事件很可能是 麻疹 的主要驱动因素,其结果因局部免疫而异,并强调了分子 监测 在 麻疹 暴发 管理中的关键作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,维持高 疫苗接种 覆盖率和快速 基因组监测 对于 麻疹 暴发 控制的重要性,因为 疫苗接种 覆盖率下降对 麻疹 消除状态构成严重风险。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,受到排除来自已确定的 麻疹 阳性位置的样本以及公共存储库中缺乏最新全局序列数据的限制,这可能导致缺失中间多样性。

papers.title: Multi-pathogen serosurveillance of vaccine preventable and neglected tropical diseases in Samoa 2018-2024 to inform public health action
papers.abstract: BackgroundSerosurveillance can estimate the prevalence of antibodies (Ab) acquired through vaccination or current and/or past infection. Multi-pathogen serosurveillance that measures multiple Ab simultaneously, can enable identification of vulnerable sub-populations with immunity gaps to vaccine preventable diseases (VPD) and concurrent burden of neglected tropical disease (NTD), including those nearing elimination (lymphatic filariasis [LF], trachoma) and eradication (yaws). This study aimed to estimate seroprevalence and identify temporal trends of selected VPDs and NTDs in Samoa to inform targeted public health action. Methodology/Principal FindingsDried blood spots were collected from four repeated community-based surveys in eight primary sampling units (PSU) in Samoa in 2018, 2019, 2023 and 2024. Multiplex bead assays were used to detect Abs against antigens (Ag) for diphtheria, measles, rubella, tetanus, LF [Wb123 or Bm14], yaws [both Rp17 and TmpA; <14 years only], and trachoma [Pgp3; <14 years only]. Seroprevalence estimates were adjusted for sampling design and standardised for age and sex. Overall, 2,871 participants were included in this analysis. Seroprevalence of measles increased from 42% in 2018 to 95% in 2024, whereas diphtheria decreased from 79% in 2018 to 65% in 2024. Seroprevalence to yaws remained <1% for all years, whereas trachoma decreased from 21% to 7% (2018-2024). LF seroprevalence decreased between 2018 and 2024 for Bm14 (37% to 9%) and increased for Wb123 (10% to 22%). This study identified 15 (0.5%) individuals who were seronegative to all VPDs (7 in 2018; 8 in 2019); of these, five were seronegative to all VPDs and seropositive to at least one NTD. Conclusions/SignificanceIdentification of sub-populations with concurrent seronegativity to VPDs and seropositivity to NTDs underscores the potential role of multi-pathogen serosurveillance in directing public health interventions to those at greatest risk. Examination of temporal patterns offer a valuable tool for measuring intervention impacts and progress towards elimination goals. Author SummaryMulti-pathogen serosurveillance that measures immune responses to multiple pathogens simultaneously, can enable the identification of vulnerable sub-populations with immunity gaps to vaccine preventable diseases and concurrent burden of neglected tropical disease, including those nearing elimination (lymphatic filariasis, trachoma) and eradication (yaws). In this study, we examined 2,871 samples collected from four repeated community-based surveys in Samoa in 2018, 2019, 2023 and 2024. We observed strong gains in immunity to measles following national vaccination efforts, while immunity to diphtheria declined over the same period. For yaws and trachoma, we saw very low or decreasing patterns, consistent with progress toward elimination. Patterns for lymphatic filariasis varied depending on the antibody marker used. Additionally, this study identified a small number of people with no immunity to vaccine preventable diseases and concurrent burden with at least one neglected tropical disease, underscoring the potential role of multi-pathogen serosurveillance in directing public health interventions to those at greatest risk.

analysis.summary_en: This study conducted multi-pathogen serosurveillance in Samoa from 2018 to 2024 to estimate seroprevalence and identify temporal trends of vaccine preventable diseases and neglected tropical diseases. Using dried blood spots from 2,871 participants across four surveys, researchers measured antibodies against diphtheria, measles, rubella, tetanus, lymphatic filariasis, yaws, and trachoma. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在估计 血清流行率 并确定萨摩亚选定的 疫苗 可预防疾病和被忽视的热带病的时间趋势,为有针对性的公共卫生行动提供信息。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 干血斑是通过 2018 年、2019 年、2023 年和 2024 年在萨摩亚的 8 个初级抽样单位进行的四次重复社区调查收集的,分析中包括 2,871 名参与者。
elements_zh.methods: 使用多重微珠测定来检测白喉、麻疹、风疹、破伤风、淋巴丝虫病、雅司病和沙眼抗原的抗体,并根据抽样设计调整 血清流行率 估计值并根据年龄和性别进行标准化。
elements_zh.main_results: 麻疹的血清流行率从2018年的42%增加到2024年的95%,而白喉从2018年的79%下降到2024年的65%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 对 疫苗 可预防疾病同时呈血清阴性和被忽视的热带病呈血清阳性的亚人群的鉴定强调了多病原体血清监测在将公共卫生干预措施引导至高危人群方面的潜在作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 对时间模式的检查为衡量干预效果和消除目标的进展提供了一个有价值的工具,特别是对于 麻疹、白喉、淋巴丝虫病、沙眼和雅司病等疾病。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,因为该研究提供了全面的血清监测数据,但仅限于抽象信息,没有详细的方法或统计分析。

Seroprevalence estimates were adjusted for sampling design and standardised for age and sex. Overall, 2,871 participants were included in this analysis. LF seroprevalence decreased between 2018 and 2024 for Bm14 (37% to 9%) and increased for Wb123 (10% to 22%). This study identified 15 (0.5%) individuals who were seronegative to all VPDs (7 in 2018; 8 in 2019); of these, five were seronegative to all VPDs and seropositive to at least one NTD. Conclusions/SignificanceIdentification of sub-populations with concurrent seronegativity to VPDs and seropositivity to NTDs underscores the potential role of multi-pathogen serosurveillance in directing public health interventions to those at greatest risk. Examination of temporal patterns offer a valuable tool for measuring intervention impacts and progress towards elimination goals. Author SummaryMulti-pathogen serosurveillance that measures immune responses to multiple pathogens simultaneously, can enable the identification of vulnerable sub-populations with immunity gaps to vaccine preventable diseases and concurrent burden of neglected tropical disease, including those nearing elimination (lymphatic filariasis, trachoma) and eradication (yaws). In this study, we examined 2,871 samples collected from four repeated community-based surveys in Samoa in 2018, 2019, 2023 and 2024. We observed strong gains in immunity to measles following national vaccination efforts, while immunity to diphtheria declined over the same period. For yaws and trachoma, we saw very low or decreasing patterns, consistent with progress toward elimination. Patterns for lymphatic filariasis varied depending on the antibody marker used. papers.title: Immunization Gaps Among High-Risk Preterm Infants in Kazakhstan
papers.abstract: Background: Advances in neonatal intensive care in Kazakhstan have improved the survival of preterm infants, including those with very low birth weight (VLBW) and extremely low birth weight (ELBW). However, after hospital discharge, these medically vulnerable children may remain insufficiently protected against vaccine-preventable infections because of prolonged temporary medical exemptions, clinical caution, parental concerns, and fragmented coordination between specialized follow-up services and primary health care. Objective: This study aimed to assess vaccination coverage in a 10-year cohort of high-risk preterm infants and to identify clinical, parental, and organizational factors associated with delayed immunization. Methods: We conducted a retrospective cohort study of 331 high-risk preterm infants followed at a specialized pediatric center in Astana, Kazakhstan, between 2015 and 2024. Vaccination status at hospital discharge and at 24 months of chronological age, documented temporary medical exemptions, reasons for delayed or missed vaccination, and confirmed cases of pertussis and measles were analyzed. A supplementary cross-sectional survey of parents, physicians, and health care managers was conducted to further explore barriers to catch-up immunization. Results: At hospital discharge, 259 infants (78.2%) had not received the BCG or hepatitis B vaccine. By 24 months of age, 34.1% (n = 113) were fully vaccinated according to age, whereas 49.8% (n = 165) remained completely unvaccinated. During the observation period, 30 cases of measles and 17 cases of pertussis were recorded within the cohort, primarily during nationwide outbreaks. Among the 10 children with a history of measles before 12 months of age, 2 developed subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE), 1 developed profound hearing loss, and 1 required prolonged oxygen therapy following pneumonia. In addition, 2 children with periventricular leukomalacia (PVL) experienced clinical deterioration, while 1 infant with pertussis required hospitalization during the acute phase of illness. Conclusion: High-risk preterm infants in this cohort experienced substantial and persistent gaps in immunization after hospital discharge. These findings underscore the importance of regular reassessment of temporary medical exemptions, improved coordination between specialized follow-up services and primary health care, and strengthened catch-up immunization strategies for medically vulnerable children.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to assess vaccination coverage in high-risk preterm infants and identify factors associated with delayed immunization, addressing gaps in protection against vaccine-preventable infections in this vulnerable population.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective cohort study of 331 high-risk preterm infants followed at a specialized pediatric center in Astana, Kazakhstan, between 2015 and 2024, supplemented by a cross-sectional survey of parents, physicians, and health care managers.
analysis.methods: Vaccination status at hospital discharge and at 24 months of chronological age, documented temporary medical exemptions, reasons for delayed or missed vaccination, and confirmed cases of pertussis and measles were analyzed.
analysis.main_results: At hospital discharge, 78.2% (259 infants) had not received the BCG or hepatitis B vaccine; by 24 months, 34.1% (113) were fully vaccinated, while 49.8% (165) remained completely unvaccinated, with 30 measles and 17 pertussis cases recorded.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as evidence of substantial and persistent immunization gaps in high-risk preterm infants, emphasizing the need for regular reassessment of temporary medical exemptions and improved coordination between specialized and primary health care services.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the need for strengthened catch-up immunization strategies for medically vulnerable children, particularly during outbreaks, to prevent severe complications like subacute sclerosing panencephalitis and other morbidities.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate, limited by the retrospective design and potential biases in self-reported data, though the large cohort size and detailed clinical documentation support the reliability of the findings.

analysis.summary_en: This study assessed vaccination coverage in 331 high-risk preterm infants in Kazakhstan, revealing significant gaps: 78.2% were unvaccinated at discharge, and 49.8% remained unvaccinated by 24 months. Thirty measles and 17 pertussis cases were recorded, with severe complications including subacute sclerosing panencephalitis in 2 children. The findings highlight the need for improved coordination between specialized and primary health care, regular reassessment of medical exemptions, and strengthened catch-up immunization strategies to protect vulnerable infants during outbreaks.

papers.title_zh: 哈萨克斯坦高危早产儿的免疫接种差距
papers.source_body_en: Background: Advances in neonatal intensive care in Kazakhstan have improved the survival of preterm infants, including those with very low birth weight (VLBW) and extremely low birth weight (ELBW). However, after hospital discharge, these medically vulnerable children may remain insufficiently protected against vaccine-preventable infections because of prolonged temporary medical exemptions, clinical caution, parental concerns, and fragmented coordination between specialized follow-up services and primary health care. Objective: This study aimed to assess vaccination coverage in a 10-year cohort of high-risk preterm infants and to identify clinical, parental, and organizational factors associated with delayed immunization. Methods: We conducted a retrospective cohort study of 331 high-risk preterm infants followed at a specialized pediatric center in Astana, Kazakhstan, between 2015 and 2024. Vaccination status at hospital discharge and at 24 months of chronological age, documented temporary medical exemptions, reasons for delayed or missed vaccination, and confirmed cases of pertussis and measles were analyzed. A supplementary cross-sectional survey of parents, physicians, and health care managers was conducted to further explore barriers to catch-up immunization. Results: At hospital discharge, 259 infants (78.2%) had not received the BCG or hepatitis B vaccine. By 24 months of age, 34.1% (n = 113) were fully vaccinated according to age, whereas 49.8% (n = 165) remained completely unvaccinated. During the observation period, 30 cases of measles and 17 cases of pertussis were recorded within the cohort, primarily during nationwide outbreaks. Among the 10 children with a history of measles before 12 months of age, 2 developed subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE), 1 developed profound hearing loss, and 1 required prolonged oxygen therapy following pneumonia. In addition, 2 children with periventricular leukomalacia (PVL) experienced clinical deterioration, while 1 infant with pertussis required hospitalization during the acute phase of illness. Conclusion: High-risk preterm infants in this cohort experienced substantial and persistent gaps in immunization after hospital discharge. These findings underscore the importance of regular reassessment of temporary medical exemptions, improved coordination between specialized follow-up services and primary health care, and strengthened catch-up immunization strategies for medically vulnerable children.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:哈萨克斯坦新生儿重症监护的进步提高了早产儿的存活率,包括极低出生体重(VLBW)和极低出生体重(ELBW)的早产儿。然而,出院后,由于长期的临时医疗豁免、临床谨慎、家长的担忧以及专门的后续服务和初级卫生保健之间的协调分散,这些医疗上脆弱的儿童可能仍然无法充分保护 疫苗 可预防的感染。目的:本研究旨在评估高危早产儿 10 年 队列研究 的 疫苗接种 覆盖率,并确定与延迟免疫相关的临床、父母和组织因素。方法:我们对 2015 年至 2024 年间在哈萨克斯坦阿斯塔纳一家专门儿科中心随访的 331 名高危早产儿进行了回顾性 队列研究 研究。出院时和 24 个月龄时的 疫苗接种 状态、记录的临时医疗豁免、延迟或错过 疫苗接种 的原因以及百日咳和确诊病例对麻疹进行了分析。对家长、医生和卫生保健管理人员进行了补充横断面调查,以进一步探讨追赶免疫接种的障碍。结果:出院时,259 名婴儿 (78.2%) 未接受卡介苗或乙型肝炎 疫苗。到 24 个月大时,34.1% (n = 113) 根据年龄完全接种了疫苗,而 49.8% (n = 165) 仍然完全未接种疫苗。观察期间,麻疹 内记录了 30 例 麻疹 病例和 17 例百日咳病例,主要发生在全国 麻疹 期间。在 12 个月前有 麻疹 病史的 10 名儿童中,2 名出现 亚急性硬化性全脑炎 (SSPE),1 名出现严重听力损失,1 名肺炎后需要长期氧疗。此外,2 名患有脑室周围白质软化症 (PVL) 的儿童出现临床恶化,而 1 名患有百日咳的婴儿在疾病急性期需要住院治疗。结论:队列研究 中的高危早产儿出院后在免疫接种方面存在显着且持续的差距。这些发现强调了定期重新评估临时医疗豁免、改善专门后续服务和初级卫生保健之间的协调以及加强针对医疗弱势儿童的补种免疫策略的重要性。

papers.title: Parents' role as advocates for and against childhood vaccination: Findings from a nationally representative survey.
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: In 2025, the US recorded the highest number of measles cases in 25 years, signaling an urgent need for renewed attention to increasing childhood vaccination coverage. To identify future intervention partners, we sought to understand parents' role in advocating for and against childhood vaccines. METHODS: A nationally representative sample of 1,315 parents of children ages 9-12 years participated in our online survey about vaccine advocacy behaviors in 2025. Separate weighted logistic regression models identified correlates of encouraging or discouraging other parents from getting routine vaccines for their children. RESULTS: Over one-third of parents reported encouraging routine vaccines sometimes or more often (36%), while about one-tenth reported discouraging vaccines (12%). These estimates include a small proportion of parents (6%) who reported both behaviors. Parents with higher confidence in the importance of vaccines for their child's health were more likely to be encouragers and less likely to be discouragers (both p < .05). Encouragers (n = 477) most often advocated for measles (50%) or seasonal flu vaccines (44%). These parents most often engaged family members and close friends, using strategies such as sharing vaccine experiences (47%), information about vaccine effectiveness (38%), and advice or opinions about vaccines (35%). Discouragers (n = 151) most often advocated against Covid-19 (53%) or seasonal flu vaccines (41%), with relatively few focusing on measles vaccine (10%). Discouragers engaged similar audiences and strategies as encouragers. CONCLUSION: Findings of our nationally representative study suggest that parents who encourage routine vaccination far outnumber those who discourage it. Given that encouragers often advocate for measles vaccine, future efforts to increase vaccination coverage should consider ways to partner with parent advocates to stem the alarming resurgence of this disease.

papers.title_zh: 父母作为儿童支持者和反对者的角色 疫苗接种:全国代表性调查的结果。
papers.source_body_en: INTRODUCTION: In 2025, the US recorded the highest number of measles cases in 25 years, signaling an urgent need for renewed attention to increasing childhood vaccination coverage. To identify future intervention partners, we sought to understand parents' role in advocating for and against childhood vaccines. METHODS: A nationally representative sample of 1,315 parents of children ages 9-12 years participated in our online survey about vaccine advocacy behaviors in 2025. Separate weighted logistic regression models identified correlates of encouraging or discouraging other parents from getting routine vaccines for their children. RESULTS: Over one-third of parents reported encouraging routine vaccines sometimes or more often (36%), while about one-tenth reported discouraging vaccines (12%). These estimates include a small proportion of parents (6%) who reported both behaviors. Parents with higher confidence in the importance of vaccines for their child's health were more likely to be encouragers and less likely to be discouragers (both p < .05). Encouragers (n = 477) most often advocated for measles (50%) or seasonal flu vaccines (44%). These parents most often engaged family members and close friends, using strategies such as sharing vaccine experiences (47%), information about vaccine effectiveness (38%), and advice or opinions about vaccines (35%). Discouragers (n = 151) most often advocated against Covid-19 (53%) or seasonal flu vaccines (41%), with relatively few focusing on measles vaccine (10%). Discouragers engaged similar audiences and strategies as encouragers. CONCLUSION: Findings of our nationally representative study suggest that parents who encourage routine vaccination far outnumber those who discourage it. Given that encouragers often advocate for measles vaccine, future efforts to increase vaccination coverage should consider ways to partner with parent advocates to stem the alarming resurgence of this disease.
papers.abstract_zh: 简介:2025 年,美国记录了 25 年来最高的 麻疹 病例数,表明迫切需要重新关注增加儿童 麻疹 覆盖率。为了确定未来的干预合作伙伴,我们试图了解父母在支持和反对儿童 疫苗 方面的角色。方法:全国范围内具有代表性的 1,315 名 9-12 岁儿童家长样本参与了我们关于 2025 年 疫苗 倡导行为的在线调查。单独的加权逻辑回归模型确定了鼓励或阻止其他家长为孩子常规使用 疫苗 的相关性。结果:超过三分之一的家长表示有时或更频繁地鼓励常规 疫苗 (36%),而约十分之一的家长表示不鼓励 疫苗 (12%)。这些估计包括一小部分报告这两种行为的父母 (6%)。对 疫苗 对孩子健康的重要性有较高信心的父母更有可能成为鼓励者,而不太可能成为劝阻者(均 p < .05)。鼓励者 (n = 477) 最常提倡 麻疹 (50%) 或季节性流感 疫苗 (44%)。这些父母最常与家人和亲密朋友接触,使用的策略包括分享 疫苗 经验 (47%)、有关 疫苗 有效性的信息 (38%) 以及有关 疫苗 的建议或意见 (35%)。劝阻者 (n = 151) 最常主张反对 Covid-19 (53%) 或季节性流感 疫苗 (41%),相对较少的人关注 麻疹 疫苗 (10%)。劝阻者的受众和策略与鼓励者相似。结论:我们的全国代表性研究结果表明,鼓励常规 疫苗接种 的父母远远多于不鼓励这样做的父母。鉴于鼓励者经常提倡 麻疹 疫苗,未来增加 疫苗接种 覆盖范围的努力应考虑如何与家长倡导者合作,以阻止这种疾病令人震惊的卷土重来。

papers.title: Effect of optimal control on SI epidemic model.
papers.abstract: In this paper, we present an optimal control analysis of a susceptible-infected (SI) epidemic model governed by a single objective function. The main purpose of this study is to minimize the number of infected individuals while reducing the cost associated with the control strategy. A dynamic control variable [Formula: see text] is introduced to represent preventive measures, such as vaccination, awareness, or treatment. The model dynamics are formulated as a system of nonlinear differential equations with bilinear incidence rate. The existence of an optimal control is established using Pontryagin's Maximum Principle, and the corresponding adjoint system and optimality conditions are derived explicitly. A numerical scheme based on the forward-backward sweep method is implemented to compute the optimal trajectories of the state and control variables. Simulation results demonstrate that the optimal control significantly reduces the infection level and maintains a high proportion of susceptible individuals over time. To demonstrate the practical applicability of the theoretical framework, we present a numerical application using measles-like epidemiological parameters, including an illustrative cost-effectiveness assessment and epidemiological interpretation. The study highlights the effectiveness of incorporating optimal control theory into epidemiological modeling for efficient disease management.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在最大限度地减少感染个体的数量,同时降低 SI 流行病模型中与控制策略相关的成本。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用了具有非线性微分方程和双线性 发病率 率的数学模型,重点关注易感感染人群。
elements_zh.methods: 采用庞特里亚金极大值原理应用最优控制理论,用动态控制变量代表预防措施,并通过前向-后向扫描方法计算数值解。
elements_zh.main_results: 正如模拟所证明的那样,最佳控制显着降低了感染水平,并随着时间的推移保持了高比例的易感个体。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调了将最优控制理论纳入流行病学模型以实现有效疾病管理的有效性,并使用类似 麻疹 的参数证明了实际适用性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果通过最佳控制为有效的疾病管理策略提供了信息,对流行病控制中的 监测、预防和成本效益评估具有影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 尽管理论框架很完善,但证据强度中等,因为该研究依赖于数学建模和模拟,而没有经过现实世界的验证。

papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中,我们提出了由单一目标函数控制的易感感染者(SI)流行病模型的最优控制分析。这项研究的主要目的是最大限度地减少感染人数,同时降低与控制策略相关的成本。引入动态控制变量[公式:见文本]来表示预防措施,例如疫苗接种、意识或治疗。模型动力学被表述为具有双线性 发病率 速率的非线性微分方程组。利用庞特里亚金极大值原理建立了最优控制的存在性,并明确导出了相应的伴随系统和最优性条件。实施基于前向-后向扫描方法的数值方案来计算状态变量和控制变量的最优轨迹。模拟结果表明,最优控制显着降低了感染水平,并随着时间的推移保持了高比例的易感个体。为了证明理论框架的实际适用性,我们提出了使用类似 麻疹 的流行病学参数的数值应用,包括说明性的成本效益评估和流行病学解释。该研究强调了将最优控制理论纳入流行病学模型以实现有效疾病管理的有效性。

papers.title: What Is Old Is New Again: Tips and Tricks for Recognizing and Treating Vaccine-Preventable Diseases of Childhood Presenting to the Emergency Department.
papers.abstract: Across the globe, there has been a resurgence in vaccine-preventable diseases reflecting declining immunity, vaccine hesitancy and gaps in vaccine coverage. Vaccination was seen as one of the most successful public health interventions of the 20th century-as a consequence, many vaccine-preventable diseases such as measles and diphtheria were relegated to textbooks. With the re-emergence of vaccine-preventable diseases (VPDs), it is an urgent priority to equip emergency physicians with the knowledge to rapidly identify and manage potential cases and strengthen public health measures to curb transmission.

papers.title: Screening for infectious diseases and vaccination status in Ukrainian paediatric refugees: a retrospective cohort study.
papers.abstract: Paediatric refugees face heightened health risks. At the same time, lack of real-world data hampers the development of evidence-based guidelines for their health care providers. The aim of the study was to assess health-care data and guideline adherence regarding paediatric Ukrainian refugees. Demographic and health-related data were collected from paediatric Ukrainian refugees who arrived in Switzerland between 24 February and 31 October 2022. Data was obtained from five participating centres. Information on infectious disease screening tests and vaccination status was extracted from a REDCap database. Adherence to national guidelines for the care of Ukrainian paediatric refugees was assessed. Of 517 children enrolled, test positivity rates were 2.7% (2/74) for HIV, 1.6% (2/125) for hepatitis B, 0.7% (2/307) for hepatitis C, and 1.0% (3/308) for tuberculosis screening. A high rate of refusal of HIV screening was observed, substantially reducing the intention-to-test rate (0.38-1.25%). Age-appropriate vaccination status was documented in 71-82% of children for measles-mumps-rubella, diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis, poliomyelitis, and Haemophilus influenzae type b. Main reason for incomplete vaccination status was vaccine hesitancy. Following arrival in Switzerland, 98% (509/517) of participants completed catch-up vaccination programmes.Conclusion: Our findings highlight challenges in the uptake of recommended infectious disease screening among paediatric refugees, underscoring the need for targeted and culturally sensitive screening strategies. The observed positivity rates provide important data to refine current screening recommendations. Moreover, the marked improvement in vaccination coverage after counselling highlights the effectiveness of addressing vaccine hesitancy in refugee populations.

analysis.methods: Demographic and health-related data were collected from paediatric Ukrainian refugees, and adherence to national guidelines for their care was assessed.

analysis.summary_en: This retrospective cohort study assessed health-care data and guideline adherence for paediatric Ukrainian refugees in Switzerland. Among 517 children, test positivity rates were low (2.7% for HIV, 1.6% for hepatitis B, 0.7% for hepatitis C, 1.0% for tuberculosis), with high refusal rates for HIV screening. Vaccination coverage was 71-82% for key vaccines, with vaccine hesitancy as the main barrier to completion. However, 98% of children completed catch-up vaccination after arrival. The findings highlight challenges in screening uptake and the effectiveness of addressing vaccine hesitancy, providing data to refine recommendations for refugee health care.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 儿科难民面临着更高的健康风险,而缺乏真实世界的数据阻碍了为其医疗保健提供者制定循证指南。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Paediatric refugees face heightened health risks, and lack of real-world data hampers the development of evidence-based guidelines for their health care providers.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A retrospective cohort study was conducted on paediatric Ukrainian refugees who arrived in Switzerland between 24 February and 31 October 2022, with data collected from five participating centres.
analysis_en.methods: Demographic and health-related data were collected from paediatric Ukrainian refugees, and adherence to national guidelines for their care was assessed.
analysis_en.main_results: Test positivity rates were 2.7% for HIV, 1.6% for hepatitis B, 0.7% for hepatitis C, and 1.0% for tuberculosis screening; age-appropriate vaccination status was documented in 71-82% of children for measles-mumps-rubella, diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis, poliomyelitis, and Haemophilus influenzae type b.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight challenges in the uptake of recommended infectious disease screening among paediatric refugees, underscoring the need for targeted and culturally sensitive screening strategies.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The observed positivity rates provide important data to refine current screening recommendations, and the marked improvement in vaccination coverage after counselling highlights the effectiveness of addressing vaccine hesitancy in refugee populations.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was retrospective and relied on existing data, which may introduce selection bias; however, the large sample size and multiple centres provide moderate confidence in the results.

papers.title_zh: 乌克兰儿科难民的传染病筛查和 疫苗接种 状况:一项回顾性 队列研究 研究。
papers.source_body_en: Paediatric refugees face heightened health risks. At the same time, lack of real-world data hampers the development of evidence-based guidelines for their health care providers. The aim of the study was to assess health-care data and guideline adherence regarding paediatric Ukrainian refugees. Demographic and health-related data were collected from paediatric Ukrainian refugees who arrived in Switzerland between 24 February and 31 October 2022. Data was obtained from five participating centres. Information on infectious disease screening tests and vaccination status was extracted from a REDCap database. Adherence to national guidelines for the care of Ukrainian paediatric refugees was assessed. Of 517 children enrolled, test positivity rates were 2.7% (2/74) for HIV, 1.6% (2/125) for hepatitis B, 0.7% (2/307) for hepatitis C, and 1.0% (3/308) for tuberculosis screening. A high rate of refusal of HIV screening was observed, substantially reducing the intention-to-test rate (0.38-1.25%). Age-appropriate vaccination status was documented in 71-82% of children for measles-mumps-rubella, diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis, poliomyelitis, and Haemophilus influenzae type b. Main reason for incomplete vaccination status was vaccine hesitancy. Following arrival in Switzerland, 98% (509/517) of participants completed catch-up vaccination programmes.Conclusion: Our findings highlight challenges in the uptake of recommended infectious disease screening among paediatric refugees, underscoring the need for targeted and culturally sensitive screening strategies. The observed positivity rates provide important data to refine current screening recommendations. Moreover, the marked improvement in vaccination coverage after counselling highlights the effectiveness of addressing vaccine hesitancy in refugee populations.
papers.abstract_zh: 儿科难民面临着更高的健康风险。与此同时,缺乏真实世界的数据阻碍了为医疗保健提供者制定循证指南。该研究的目的是评估乌克兰儿童难民的医疗保健数据和指南遵守情况。人口统计和健康相关数据是从 2022 年 2 月 24 日至 10 月 31 日期间抵达瑞士的乌克兰儿科难民中收集的。数据来自五个参与中心。有关传染病筛查测试和 疫苗接种 状态的信息是从 REDCap 数据库中提取的。对乌克兰儿科难民国家护理指南的遵守情况进行了评估。在 517 名入组儿童中,艾滋病毒检测阳性率为 2.7% (2/74),乙型肝炎检测阳性率为 1.6% (2/125),丙型肝炎检测阳性率为 0.7% (2/307),结核病筛查阳性率为 1.0% (3/308)。艾滋病毒筛查的拒绝率很高,大大降低了意向检测率(0.38-1.25%)。71-82% 的儿童记录了适合年龄的 麻疹 状态,包括 麻疹-腮腺炎-风疹、白喉-破伤风-百日咳、脊髓灰质炎和 b 型流感嗜血杆菌。疫苗接种 状态不完整的主要原因是 疫苗 犹豫不决。抵达瑞士后,98% (509/517) 的参与者完成了 疫苗接种 补习计划。结论:我们的研究结果凸显了儿童难民接受建议的传染病筛查所面临的挑战,强调了有针对性和文化敏感的筛查策略的必要性。观察到的阳性率为完善当前的筛查建议提供了重要数据。此外,咨询后 疫苗接种 覆盖率的显着改善凸显了解决难民群体中 疫苗 犹豫问题的有效性。

papers.title: Economic burden and return on investment of immunization programs in Saudi Arabia: a health economic evaluation.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Vaccine-preventable diseases (VPDs) continue to impose a significant health and economic burden globally, despite advances in immunization programs. Narrower to the context of Saudi Arabia, the current literature consistently shows that the high vaccination coverage has had the primary impact of reducing disease incidence. Regardless, the broader economic impact of VPDs and the financial benefits of immunization remain important for policy evaluation within Saudi Arabia. METHODS: This study employed a model-based economic evaluation using a societal perspective in order to carry out an estimation of the economic burden of measles, influenza, and pneumococcal diseases. We utilized the Cost of Illness (COI) approach for the purpose of quantifying direct medical costs and indirect productivity losses. On the other hand, the Value of Statistical Life (VSL) approach helped in the estimation of the monetary value of mortality reduction. A comparative framework analyzed current vaccination coverage against a counterfactual no-vaccination scenario for the calculation of the return on investment (ROI). RESULTS: The estimated annual economic burden of the three selected VPDs in the absence of vaccination was USD 385 (95% CI: 315-460) million. Immunization programs generated substantial economic benefits, with total benefits estimated at USD 1085 (95% CI: 815-1360) million annually. The calculated ROI was 9.85 (95% CI: 6.8-11.3), essentially an indication that for each dollar invested in vaccination, there was multiple economic returns yielded. Sensitivity analyses confirmed the robustness of these findings. CONCLUSION: Immunization programs in Saudi Arabia provide significant economic and public health benefits and for this reason, sustained investment in vaccination is fundamentally essential towards the reduction of disease burden, improve population health, and ultimately support long-term economic productivity.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 尽管免疫规划取得了进展,但 疫苗 可预防疾病 (VPD) 继续在全球范围内造成重大的健康和经济负担。VPD 更广泛的经济影响和免疫接种的经济效益对于沙特阿拉伯的政策评估仍然很重要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究采用基于模型的经济评估,从社会角度来估计沙特阿拉伯 麻疹、流感和肺炎球菌疾病的经济负担。
elements_zh.methods: The Cost of Illness (COI) approach was used to quantify direct medical costs and indirect productivity losses,while the Value of Statistical Life (VSL) approach estimated the monetary value of 死亡率 reduction.比较框架根据反事实的无 疫苗接种 场景分析了当前的 疫苗接种 覆盖范围,以计算投资回报 (ROI)。
elements_zh.main_results: 在没有 疫苗接种 的情况下,三个选定的 VPD 的估计年度经济负担为 385 万美元(95% CI:315-460)百万美元。免疫计划产生了巨大的经济效益,每年总效益估计为 1085 万美元(95% CI:815-1360)百万美元。计算得出的 ROI 为 9.85(95% CI:6.8-11.3),表明投资 疫苗接种 的每一美元都会带来多重经济回报。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 沙特阿拉伯的免疫计划提供了显着的经济和公共卫生效益,对 疫苗接种 的持续投资对于减轻疾病负担和改善人口健康至关重要。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持对 疫苗接种 的持续投资,以减轻疾病负担、改善人口健康并支持沙特阿拉伯的长期经济生产力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据没有报告具体的局限性或偏见。证据强度很高,因为该研究采用了包括敏感性分析在内的稳健方法来证实研究结果。

papers.title_zh: 沙特阿拉伯免疫计划的经济负担和投资回报:健康经济评估。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Vaccine-preventable diseases (VPDs) continue to impose a significant health and economic burden globally, despite advances in immunization programs. Narrower to the context of Saudi Arabia, the current literature consistently shows that the high vaccination coverage has had the primary impact of reducing disease incidence. Regardless, the broader economic impact of VPDs and the financial benefits of immunization remain important for policy evaluation within Saudi Arabia. METHODS: This study employed a model-based economic evaluation using a societal perspective in order to carry out an estimation of the economic burden of measles, influenza, and pneumococcal diseases. We utilized the Cost of Illness (COI) approach for the purpose of quantifying direct medical costs and indirect productivity losses. On the other hand, the Value of Statistical Life (VSL) approach helped in the estimation of the monetary value of mortality reduction. A comparative framework analyzed current vaccination coverage against a counterfactual no-vaccination scenario for the calculation of the return on investment (ROI). RESULTS: The estimated annual economic burden of the three selected VPDs in the absence of vaccination was USD 385 (95% CI: 315-460) million. Immunization programs generated substantial economic benefits, with total benefits estimated at USD 1085 (95% CI: 815-1360) million annually. The calculated ROI was 9.85 (95% CI: 6.8-11.3), essentially an indication that for each dollar invested in vaccination, there was multiple economic returns yielded. Sensitivity analyses confirmed the robustness of these findings. CONCLUSION: Immunization programs in Saudi Arabia provide significant economic and public health benefits and for this reason, sustained investment in vaccination is fundamentally essential towards the reduction of disease burden, improve population health, and ultimately support long-term economic productivity.

papers.title: Pediatric Vaccination in a Changing World. Impact on Child Health, Vaccine Hesitancy, and Future Perspectives of Immunization
papers.abstract: Introduction: Vaccination remains one of the most effective and cost‐efficient public health interventions, dramatically reducing childhood morbidity and mortality from vaccine‐preventable diseases. However, the global immunization landscape has recently been challenged by pandemic disruptions, misinformation, inequities in access, and resurgent outbreaks. The Aim is to synthesize current evidence on the health and societal impact of pediatric vaccination, examine determinants of vaccine hesitancy, and highlight future perspectives for immunization programs. Methods; A narrative review was conducted, integrating epidemiological data, modelling studies, and recent reports from WHO, UNICEF, and peer‐reviewed literature. Particular attention was given to trends in coverage, disease resurgence, and behavioral determinants of vaccine confidence. Results: Routine immunization has averted an estimated 154 million deaths since 1974, predominantly in children under five. Yet, in 2024, 14.3 million infants received no vaccine doses, and measles re‐emerged in multiple countries, threatening elimination status. Vaccine hesitancy was strongly influenced by misinformation, sociocultural factors, and trust in health systems. Evidence underscores that resilient health infrastructure, equitable access, and credible communication by frontline providers are essential to sustain progress. Conclusions: Scientific advances alone cannot secure immunization gains. Strengthening public trust, addressing behavioral determinants, and ensuring equitable delivery are critical for the future of pediatric vaccination.

papers.title: Impact of Enhanced Outreach Activities on Immunization Coverage in Pakistan: Evidence from Secondary Data Analysis (2011–2021)
papers.abstract: Background: Despite noteworthy progress in the Expanded Program on Immunization (EPI) for improving vaccination coverage worldwide, inequalities in vaccine uptake and accessibility persist in several middle- and low-income states. Pakistan’s routine vaccination uptake varies greatly between federal geographical regions and continues to fall below the standard threshold needed to attain optimal herd immunity. The Federal Directorate of Immunization (FDI) in collaboration with the provincial Expanded Program on Immunizations implemented Enhanced Outreach Activities (EOAs) to boost immunization delivery in selected districts in order to address immunization coverage gaps in marginalized and difficult-to-reach communities. The purpose of this secondary data research was to evaluate whether EOAs improved immunization coverage in the country. Methods: The Federal Directorate of Immunization’s longitudinal panel analysis of district–month administrative data for the years 2011–2021 have been analyzed. The research investigation reviewed 158 districts’ monthly vaccination records for multiple antigens, covering regions where EOAs were successfully carried out in particular months. National and subnational analyses were carried out to measure geographical variations in the impact of Enhanced Outreach Activities (EOAs). The average vaccination coverage during EOAs and non-EOAs months was compared using the paired t-test. Results: An aggregate of 2430 months with EOAs were included in the analysis of 19,068 monthly district observations. National level analysis revealed higher average vaccinations during the EOA months for all antigens, but a statistically significant increase was observed for IPV and measles second dose (p < 0.05) only. Provincial-level results indicate that the impact was more evident in underserved regions. Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Balochistan, Punjab, and Sindh demonstrated statistically significant increases in vaccination counts for most antigens. Due to variations in baseline population coverage, as well as health care sector capability, the extent of improvements differed throughout regions. Conclusions: In Pakistan, routine immunization counts has been improved via enhanced outreach initiatives, especially in provinces with lower initial vaccination rates and restricted accessibility to services. Strengthening outreach strategies, together with consistent fixed-site immunization services, is likely to accelerate progress toward equitable immunization coverage and contribute to achieving the Immunization Agenda 2030 goals.

source_records.title: Impact of Enhanced Outreach Activities on Immunization Coverage in Pakistan: Evidence from Secondary Data Analysis (2011–2021)
source_records.abstract: Background: Despite noteworthy progress in the Expanded Program on Immunization (EPI) for improving vaccination coverage worldwide, inequalities in vaccine uptake and accessibility persist in several middle- and low-income states. Pakistan’s routine vaccination uptake varies greatly between federal geographical regions and continues to fall below the standard threshold needed to attain optimal herd immunity. The Federal Directorate of Immunization (FDI) in collaboration with the provincial Expanded Program on Immunizations implemented Enhanced Outreach Activities (EOAs) to boost immunization delivery in selected districts in order to address immunization coverage gaps in marginalized and difficult-to-reach communities. The purpose of this secondary data research was to evaluate whether EOAs improved immunization coverage in the country. Methods: The Federal Directorate of Immunization’s longitudinal panel analysis of district–month administrative data for the years 2011–2021 have been analyzed. The research investigation reviewed 158 districts’ monthly vaccination records for multiple antigens, covering regions where EOAs were successfully carried out in particular months. National and subnational analyses were carried out to measure geographical variations in the impact of Enhanced Outreach Activities (EOAs). The average vaccination coverage during EOAs and non-EOAs months was compared using the paired t-test. Results: An aggregate of 2430 months with EOAs were included in the analysis of 19,068 monthly district observations. National level analysis revealed higher average vaccinations during the EOA months for all antigens, but a statistically significant increase was observed for IPV and measles second dose (p < 0.05) only. Provincial-level results indicate that the impact was more evident in underserved regions. Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Balochistan, Punjab, and Sindh demonstrated statistically significant increases in vaccination counts for most antigens. Due to variations in baseline population coverage, as well as health care sector capability, the extent of improvements differed throughout regions. Conclusions: In Pakistan, routine immunization counts has been improved via enhanced outreach initiatives, especially in provinces with lower initial vaccination rates and restricted accessibility to services. Strengthening outreach strategies, together with consistent fixed-site immunization services, is likely to accelerate progress toward equitable immunization coverage and contribute to achieving the Immunization Agenda 2030 goals.

analysis.scope_and_question: The study focuses on evaluating the impact of Enhanced Outreach Activities (EOAs) on immunization coverage in Pakistan, particularly targeting measles virus and related entities. The central question is whether these outreach initiatives improved vaccination rates, especially for measles and other antigens, in marginalized and difficult-to-reach communities.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The evidence base consists of longitudinal panel data from the Federal Directorate of Immunization (FDI) covering 2011–2021. The review method involved analyzing district–month administrative data for 158 districts, comparing vaccination coverage during EOA months with non-EOA months using a paired t-test. National and subnational analyses were conducted to assess geographical variations in the impact of EOAs.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The study found that national-level analysis revealed higher average vaccinations during EOA months for all antigens, with statistically significant increases for measles second dose and IPV (p < 0.05). Provincial-level results indicated that the impact was more pronounced in underserved regions, with Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Balochistan, Punjab, and Sindh showing significant improvements in vaccination counts for most antigens. The conclusion is that enhanced outreach initiatives have improved routine immunization coverage, particularly in provinces with lower initial vaccination rates and restricted service accessibility.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The study acknowledges variations in baseline population coverage and healthcare sector capability, which may explain differing extents of improvement across regions. analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The findings suggest that strengthening outreach strategies, in conjunction with fixed-site immunization services, could accelerate progress toward equitable immunization coverage. elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该研究的重点是评估加强外展活动 (EOAs) 对巴基斯坦免疫覆盖率的影响,特别是针对 麻疹病毒 和相关实体。核心问题是,这些外展活动是否提高了边缘化和难以接触社区的 麻疹 率,尤其是 麻疹 和其他抗原。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 证据基础由联邦免疫局 (FDI) 2011-2021 年的纵向面板数据组成。审查方法包括分析 158 个地区的地区月行政数据,使用配对 t 检验比较 EOA 月份和非 EOA 月份的 疫苗接种 覆盖率。进行了国家和地方分析,以评估EOA影响的地理差异。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 研究发现,国家级分析显示,所有抗原在 EOA 月份期间的平均 麻疹 均较高,麻疹 第二剂和 IPV 的增加具有统计学意义(p < 0.05)。省级结果表明,这种影响在服务欠缺的地区更为明显,其中开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省、俾路支省、旁遮普省和信德省的大多数抗原的 疫苗接种 计数显示出显着改善。结论是,加强外展活动提高了常规免疫覆盖率,特别是在初始 疫苗接种 率较低且服务可及性有限的省份。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该研究承认基线人口覆盖率和医疗保健部门能力存在差异,这可能解释了不同地区改善程度不同的原因。然而,它没有提供影响这些差异的具体机制或背景因素的详细信息。此外,该研究并未解决观察期之后 EOA 的长期可持续性或有效性。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果表明,加强外展战略与固定地点免疫服务相结合,可以加速实现公平免疫覆盖的进展。该研究强调了在服务欠缺地区采取有针对性的干预措施的必要性,并强调了一致实施 EOA 以实现 2030 年免疫议程目标的重要性。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:尽管扩大免疫计划(EPI)在提高全球 疫苗接种 覆盖率方面取得了显着进展,但在一些中低收入国家,疫苗 的吸收和可及性仍然存在不平等。巴基斯坦的常规 疫苗接种 吸收率在联邦地理区域之间差异很大,并且持续低于获得最佳群体免疫力所需的标准阈值。联邦免疫局 (FDI) 与省级免疫扩大计划合作实施了强化外展活动 (EOA),以促进选定地区的免疫接种服务,以解决边缘化和难以到达的社区的免疫覆盖率差距。这项二手数据研究的目的是评估 EOA 是否提高了该国的免疫覆盖率。方法:对联邦免疫局 2011-2021 年地区月行政数据的纵向面板分析进行了分析。该研究调查审查了 158 个地区的多种抗原的每月 疫苗接种 记录,涵盖了特定月份成功开展 EOA 的地区。进行了国家和国家以下各级的分析,以衡量加强外展活动 (EOAs) 影响的地理差异。使用配对 t 检验比较 EOA 和非 EOA 月份的平均 疫苗接种 覆盖率。结果:对 19,068 个月地区观察结果的分析中纳入了总计 2430 个月的 EOA。国家级分析显示,所有抗原在 EOA 月份期间的平均 麻疹 均较高,但仅在 IPV 和 麻疹 第二剂中观察到统计学上显着的增加 (p < 0.05)。省级结果表明,服务欠缺地区的影响更为明显。开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省、俾路支省、旁遮普省和信德省表现出大多数抗原的 疫苗接种 计数在统计学上显着增加。由于基线人口覆盖率以及医疗保健部门能力的差异,各地区的改善程度有所不同。结论:在巴基斯坦,通过加强外展活动,常规免疫计数得到了改善,特别是在初始 疫苗接种 率较低且服务可及性有限的省份。加强外展战略,加上一致的固定地点免疫服务,可能会加速实现公平免疫覆盖率的进展,并有助于实现《2030 年免疫议程》目标。

papers.title: Classification of scenarios based on the determinants of childhood vaccination coverage in Brazil
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background Vaccination coverage in Brazil declined between 2015 and 2022, followed by a recovery in 2023 and 2024. Given this instability, driven by multiple determinants, we sought to identify factors associated with childhood vaccination and group Brazilian municipalities into scenarios that could guide interventions to improve coverage. Methods In this ecological study of 5,274 Brazilian municipalities, we assessed the rate of children under 1 year unvaccinated with the third dose of the Inactivated Poliovirus Vaccine (IPV) in 2024, chosen for its high correlation with other tracer vaccines such as Diphtheria, Tetanus and Pertussis (DTP) and Measles, Mumps and Rubella (MMR). We applied a hierarchical model with three levels of determinants (socioeconomic, health service structure, and operational), using Poisson regression to estimate standardized Rate Ratios (RR), followed by a K-means cluster analysis to identify municipal profiles. Results Several determinants were associated with higher rates of unvaccinated children, most notably the proportion of the population not covered by Community Health Workers (CHW) (RR = 1.15; 95% CI 1.14-1.15) and inequality measured by the Gini Index (RR = 1.33; 95% CI 1.32-1.34). We identified six municipal profiles that differed in tracer-vaccine coverage up to four years of age and in the composite Vaccination Needs Index (VNI). Conclusion Multiple socioeconomic, structural and operational factors were associated with unvaccinated rates, highlighting the relevance of healthcare service organization even in favorable social contexts. Classifying municipalities into risk profiles may support more targeted interventions aligned with local needs.

papers.title: Assessment of post-vaccination immunity to airborne infections in children and adolescents from the Republic of Karelia
papers.abstract: Seroepidemiological studies are essential for epidemiological surveillance of vaccine-preventable airborne infections prevented in children through using combination vaccines. The aim of the study was to assess post-vaccination immunity to diphtheria, pertussis, measles, rubella and mumps in children and adolescents living in the Republic of Karelia. Materials and methods. Results of seromonitoring in study groups of children and adolescents in the Republic of Karelia in 2019–2024 were retrospectively analyzed. A high level of immunological protection was established only for diphtheria (0.7% seronegative among children 3–4 years and 1.0% among adolescents 16–17 years) and rubella (3–4 years — 1.7%, 9–10 years — 0.9%, 16–17 years — 2.2%). A total of 2.4% of children aged 3–4 years had no protective antibody titer to pertussis microbe in 2019–2021 and 67.9% in 2022–2024. The increase in the frequency of seronegative children coincided with increased incidence of infection and the beginning of using acellular vaccine. The agglutination test allows the detection of antibodies to the microorganism, but not to toxoid. The percentage of measles and mumps seronegative children aged 3–4 years was 9.1% and 19.5%, 9–10 years — 17.6% and 8.8%, among adolescents — 36.5% and 17.4%. An analysis of the epidemiological situation showed that seromonitoring data mirrored the state of post-vaccination immunity. The presence of antibodies to rubella in children seronegative to measles and mumps, and antitoxic antibodies to diphtheria at a high level in children seronegative to pertussis, excludes falsification of vaccination data or loss of vaccine immunogenicity due to violation of storage temperature conditions as potential causes of negative results. Our results demonstrate the importance of assessing antibodies to all simultaneously administered antigens and a need to expand a search for causes behind substantial level of seropositivity among children.

papers.title: A new fractional order Rubella disease model and systems analysis
papers.abstract: Abstract The field of modelling infectious and chronic diseases is of pivotal importance in determining treatment and prevention methods. A plethora of diseases and public health concerns, including but not limited to measles, influenza, cancer and HIV, are analysed through the utilisation of mathematical models. Decision support studies are conducted to ensure the effective utilisation of available resources. At this juncture, the modelling of epidemiological diseases has a significant role to play in the estimation of the course of the epidemic within the society. In this study, a novel fractional order rubella disease model is considered. The numerical implementation and stability analysis of the model are performed. The notion of fractional derivatives is employed in the Caputo sense. Mathematical analyses of the fractional-order rubella disease model are conducted and numerical results are obtained through the implementation of the Generalized Euler method. Graphs are then generated to illustrate the findings. Based on the results of the sensitivity analysis, assuming all other parameters remain constant, the fundamental parameters represented by the transmission rate and the birth/natural death rates exhibit positive sensitivity indicators. Elevated values of these parameters have been determined to exert a substantial influence on the propagation of rubella within the community. Conversely, an increase in ratios with negative sensitivity indicators, such as the recovery rate and vaccination rate, has been demonstrated to function as a control mechanism to minimize the spread of rubella. Consequently, monitoring and managing these parameters should be prioritized by healthcare providers and policymakers to achieve the successful eradication of rubella.
papers.journal: Journal of Nonlinear Complex and Data Science

papers.title_zh: 一种新的分数阶风疹疾病模型和系统分析
papers.source_body_en: Abstract The field of modelling infectious and chronic diseases is of pivotal importance in determining treatment and prevention methods. A plethora of diseases and public health concerns, including but not limited to measles, influenza, cancer and HIV, are analysed through the utilisation of mathematical models. Decision support studies are conducted to ensure the effective utilisation of available resources. At this juncture, the modelling of epidemiological diseases has a significant role to play in the estimation of the course of the epidemic within the society. In this study, a novel fractional order rubella disease model is considered. The numerical implementation and stability analysis of the model are performed. The notion of fractional derivatives is employed in the Caputo sense. Mathematical analyses of the fractional-order rubella disease model are conducted and numerical results are obtained through the implementation of the Generalized Euler method. Graphs are then generated to illustrate the findings. Based on the results of the sensitivity analysis, assuming all other parameters remain constant, the fundamental parameters represented by the transmission rate and the birth/natural death rates exhibit positive sensitivity indicators. Elevated values of these parameters have been determined to exert a substantial influence on the propagation of rubella within the community. Conversely, an increase in ratios with negative sensitivity indicators, such as the recovery rate and vaccination rate, has been demonstrated to function as a control mechanism to minimize the spread of rubella. Consequently, monitoring and managing these parameters should be prioritized by healthcare providers and policymakers to achieve the successful eradication of rubella.

papers.title: A Situation Analysis of Parental Awareness Regarding Childhood Hearing Loss to Inform Health Communication Strategy
papers.abstract: Introduction Early detection through universal newborn hearing screening (UNHS) and timely intervention can improve speech, language, and cognitive outcomes. However, limited awareness among caregivers remains a major barrier to early identification and management. This study performed a situation analysis of parental knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) to identify strategic barriers and inform a targeted health communication strategy. Methods A cross-sectional, questionnaire-based study was conducted at a tertiary care hospital in North India from November 2023 to October 2024. A total of 494 participants were recruited. Data were collected through a pre-validated, semi-structured questionnaire administered via face-to-face interviews in Hindi. The tool collected data on knowledge of risk factors and early diagnosis, attitudes toward screening and treatment, and practices related to prevention and care-seeking. Following data collection, a situation analysis and SWOT (strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats) matrix were developed using the Johns Hopkins "P-Process" framework to synthesize raw findings into a strategic roadmap. Results The situation analysis revealed a "service-utilization paradox": while 420 (85.0%) of participants supported newborn hearing screening, a profound "follow-up apathy" existed, with 454 (91.9%) incorrectly perceiving subsequent testing as unnecessary. Knowledge of "visible" risks like ear discharge (459, 92.9%) and measles (405, 82.0%) was high, but awareness of "invisible" prenatal and perinatal risks, such as NICU stays and maternal infections, remained poor. The SWOT analysis identified high graduate-level literacy and vaccination compliance (396, 80.2%) as core strengths and opportunities. However, these were countered by a lack of awareness of government facilities (30, 6.1%) and an external threat of outcome pessimism, where fewer than half of the participants believed normal speech development was possible for affected children. Conclusions The study underscores a strategic opportunity to leverage high vaccination compliance by integrating hearing health education into immunization clinics. Targeted communication strategies must focus on addressing follow-up apathy and outcome misconceptions to bridge the gap between initial screening and long-term rehabilitation.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2023 年 11 月至 2024 年 10 月,在印度北部的一家三级护理医院开展了一项基于问卷调查的横断面研究,招募了 494 名参与者。
elements_zh.methods: 通过印地语面对面访谈进行预先验证的半结构化调查问卷收集数据,然后使用约翰霍普金斯大学的“P-Process”框架进行情况分析和 SWOT 矩阵。
elements_zh.main_results: 该研究揭示了一个“服务利用悖论”:85.0%的参与者支持新生儿听力筛查,但91.9%的参与者错误地认为后续测试是不必要的。对耳部分泌物(92.9%)和麻疹(82.0%)等“看得见的”风险的了解程度很高,但对“看不见的”产前和围产期风险的认识仍然很差。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为强调了通过将听力健康教育纳入免疫诊所、解决后续冷漠和结果误解来利用高 疫苗接种 合规性的战略机会。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为有针对性的沟通策略提供了信息,以弥合初步筛查和长期康复之间的差距,强调将听力健康教育纳入免疫诊所。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是在印度北部的一家三级护理医院进行的,限制了普遍性。然而,由于样本量大且方法经过验证,证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 引言 通过新生儿普遍听力筛查(UNHS)进行早期检测和及时干预可以改善言语、语言和认知结果。然而,照顾者认知有限仍然是早期识别和管理的主要障碍。本研究对父母的知识、态度和实践(KAP)进行了情况分析,以确定战略障碍并为有针对性的健康传播策略提供信息。方法 于2023年11月至2024年10月在印度北部的一家三级护理医院进行了一项横断面、基于问卷的研究。共招募了494名参与者。数据通过预先验证的半结构化问卷收集,通过印地语面对面访谈进行。该工具收集了关于风险因素和早期诊断的知识、对筛查和治疗的态度以及与预防和就医相关的实践。数据收集后,使用约翰霍普金斯"P-Process"框架制定情况分析和SWOT(优势、劣势、机会和威胁)矩阵,将原始结果综合为战略路线图。结果 情况分析揭示了一个"服务利用悖论":虽然420名(85.0%)参与者支持新生儿听力筛查,但存在严重的"随访冷漠",有454名(91.9%)错误地认为后续检测不必要。对"可见"风险(如耳漏(459名,92.9%)和麻疹(405名,82.0%))的认知程度高,但对"不可见"的产前和围产期风险(如NICU住院和母体感染)的认知仍然较差。SWOT分析将高学历水平和疫苗接种依从性(396名,80.2%)确定为核心优势和机会。然而,这些优势受到对政府设施认知不足(30名,6.1%)和外部威胁(结果悲观主义)的抵消,即不到一半的参与者认为受影响儿童能够实现正常的言语发育。结论 该研究强调了一个战略机会,即通过将听力健康教育整合到免疫接种诊所,利用高疫苗接种依从性。有针对性的传播策略必须专注于解决随访冷漠和结果误解问题,以弥合初始筛查与长期康复之间的差距。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 2023 年 11 月至 2024 年 10 月,在印度北部的一家三级护理医院开展了一项基于问卷调查的横断面研究,招募了 494 名参与者。
analysis_zh.methods: 通过印地语面对面访谈进行预先验证的半结构化调查问卷收集数据,然后使用约翰霍普金斯大学的“P-Process”框架进行情况分析和 SWOT 矩阵。

papers.title: Lettice Kinnersley
papers.abstract: Lettice Kinnersley (1573–1632) was the youngest daughter of Richard Bagot (1530–1597) and Mary Saunders (b. She had two older brothers, Walter (1557–1622) and Anthony (b. 1558), and three older sisters, Margaret Trew (1551–1587), Ann Broughton (1555–1619), and Dorothy Okeover (1562–1628). In 1601, at the age of 28, she married Francis Kinnersley. They had a son, Thomas, in 1603, and perhaps two other boys, Ned and Dick, who are mentioned as having measles in a letter from her husband to her brother. Francis was estranged from his father, Anthony Kinnersley, and both Lettice and Francis came to rely on Lettice’s oldest brother, Walter Bagot, who had inherited her father’s estate in 1597, as an intermediary and confidant. Lettice’s marriage was fraught with financial and familial difficulties.
